Jahalat-o-khabasat ki inteha Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk hai. Aye Nabi (ﷺ)! Aap elaan kar dijiye ke agar bilfarz Allah Ta'ala ki aulad ho to mujhe sar jhukane mein kya ta'ammul hai? Na main uske farman se sartabi karoon na uske hukum ko taloon. Agar aisa hota to sab se pehle main use manta aur uska iqrar karta, lekin Allah ki zaat aisi nahin jiska koi hamsar aur jiska koi kufw ho. Yaad rahe ke bator-e-shart ke jo kalam warid kiya jaye uska waqoo zaroori nahin balkay imkan bhi zaroori nahin. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai, Ayat: (Lau aradallahu an yattakhiza waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashau, subhanahu, huwallahul wahidul qahhar) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4), yani agar Hazrat-e-Haq Jalla Wa 'Ala aulad ki khwahish karta to apni makhlooq mein se jise chahta chun leta, lekin woh is se pak hai. Uski shan-e-wahdaniyat iske khilaf hai, uska tanha ghalba aur qahariyat iske sareeh munafi hai. Ba'az mufassireen ne (Aabideen) ke ma'ani inkari ke bhi kiye hain, jaise Sufyan Sauri. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke (Aabideen) se murad yahan (Awwalul Jahideen) hai, yani pehla inkar karne wala aur yeh (Abada-Ya'budu) ke baab se hai aur jo ibadat ke ma'ani mein hota hai, woh (Abada-Ya'budu) se hota hai. Isi ki shahadat mein yeh waqia bhi hai ke ek aurat ke nikah ke chhe mah baad bacha hua, Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne use rajam karne ka hukum diya lekin Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne uski mukhalifat ki aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mein hai, Ayat: (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 15), yani hamal ki aur doodh ki chhutai ki muddat dhai saal ki hai. Aur jagah Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya, Ayat: (Wa fisaluhu fi 'aamain), do saal ke andar andar doodh chhudane ki muddat hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) unka inkar na kar sake aur foran aadmi bheja ke is aurat ko wapas karo. Yahan bhi lafz (Abada) hai, yani inkar na kar sake. Ibn-e-Wahb kehte hain (Abada) ke ma'ani na manna, inkar karna hai. Shair ke sher mein bhi (Abada) inkar ke aur na manne ke ma'ani mein hai. Lekin is qaul mein nazar hai, is liye ke shart ke jawab mein yeh kuch theek tor par lagta nahin. Ise manne ke baad matlab yeh hoga ke agar Rahman ki aulad hai to main pehla munkir hoon aur is mein kalam ki khoobsurti qaim nahin rehti. Haan sirf yeh keh sakte hain ke (In) shart ke liye nahin hai, balkay nafi ke liye hai, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool bhi hai. To ab mazmoon-e-kalam yeh hoga ke chunke Rahman ki aulad nahin, pas main uska pehla gawah hoon. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain yeh kalam Arab ke muhawaray ke mutabiq hai, yani na Rahman ki aulad, na main uska qail-o-aabid. Abu Sakhr farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke main to pehle hi uska aabid hoon ke uski aulad hai hi nahin aur main uski tauheed ko manne mein bhi aagay aagay hoon. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain main uska pehla ibadat guzar hoon aur muwahhid hoon aur tumhari takzeeb karne wala hoon.

Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain main pehla inkari hoon yeh dono lughat mein (Aabid) aur (Abd) aur awwal hi zyada qareeb hai is wajah se ke yeh shart-o-jaza hai lekin yeh mumtani aur muhaal mehaz namumkin. Suddi (R.H) farmate hain agar is ki aulad hoti toh main ise pehle maan leta ke is ki aulad hai lekin woh is se paak hai. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain aur jo log (An) ko nafiya batlate hain un ke qaul ki tardeed karte hain. Isi liye Bari Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke aasman-o-zameen aur tamam cheezon ka haal is se paak bahut door aur bilkul munazzah hai ke is ki aulad ho, woh Fard, Ahad, Samad hai, is ki nazeer, kufw, aulad koi nahin. Irshad hota hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inhe apni jahalat mein ghote khate chhodo aur duniya ke khel tamashon mein mashghool rehne do, isi ghaflat mein in par Qayamat toot padegi. Us waqt apna anjam maloom kar lenge. Phir Zaat-e-Haq ki buzurgi aur azmat aur jalal ka mazeed bayan hota hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooqat is ki aabid hai, is ke samne past aur aajiz hai. Woh Khabeer-o-Aleem hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke zameen-o-aasman mein Allah wahi hai, har posheeda aur zahir ko aur tumhare har har amal ko janta hai, woh sab ka Khaliq-o-Malik, sab ko basane aur banane wala, sab par hukumat aur saltanat rakhne wala, badi barkaton wala hai. Woh tamam aibon se, kul nuqsanat se paak hai, woh sab ka malik hai, bulandiyon aur azmaton wala hai, koi nahin jo is ka hukum taal sake, koi nahin jo is ki marzi badal sake, har ek par qabiz wahi hai, har ek kaam is ki qudrat ke matahat hai. Qayamat aane ke waqt ko wahi janta hai, is ke siwa kisi ko is ke aane ke theek waqt ka ilm nahin. Sari makhlooq isi ki taraf lautayi jayegi, woh har ek ko apne apne aamal ka badla dega. Phir irshad hota hai ke in kafiron ke maboodan-e-batil jinhein yeh apna sifarshi khayal kiye baithe hain, un mein se koi bhi sifarish ke liye aage badh nahin sakta, kisi ki shafa'at inhe kaam na aayegi. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, yani lekin jo shakhs haq ka iqrari aur shahid ho aur woh khud bhi baseerat-o-basarat par yani ilm-o-ma'rifat wala ho, use Allah ke hukum se nek logon ki shafa'at kaar-aamad hogi. In se agar tu pooche ke in ka Khaliq kaun hai? Toh yeh iqrar karenge ke Allah hi hai. Afsos ke Khaliq isi ek ko maan kar phir ibadat dusron ki bhi karte hain jo mehaz majboor aur bilkul be-qudrat hain aur kabhi apni aql ko kaam mein nahin late ke jab paida isi ek ne kiya toh hum dusre ki ibadat kyun karein? Jahalat-o-khabasat, kund zehni aur be-waqoofi itni badh gayi hai ke aisi seedhi si baat marte dam tak samajh na aayi. Balkay samjhane se bhi na samjha, isi liye ta'ajjub se irshad hua ke itna maante hue phir kyun andhe ho jate ho? Phir irshad hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna yeh kehna kaha yani apne Rab ki taraf shikayat ki aur apni qaum ki takzeeb ka bayan kiya ke yeh iman qabool nahin karte, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa Qalar Rasulu Ya Rabbi Inna Qaumittakhazu Hazal Qur'ana Mahjoora) (Surah Al-Furqan: 30).

(Al-Furqan: 30) Ya'ni Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh shikayat Allah ke samne hogi ke meri ummat ne is Quran ko chhor rakha tha. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi yahi tafsir bayan karte hain. Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qira'at laam ke zer ke sath bhi naqal ki hai. Is ki ek taujih toh yeh ho sakti hai ke aayat (Am yahsabuna anna la nasma'u sirrahum wa najwahum, bala wa rusuluna ladaihim yaktubun) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 80) par ma'toof hai. Dusre yeh ke yahan fe'l muqaddar mana jaye ya'ni (Qala) ko muqaddar mana jaye. Dusri qira'at ya'ni laam ke zer ke sath jab ho toh yeh ataf hoga aayat (Wa indahu ilmus-sa'ati wa ilaihi turja'un) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 85) par, toh taqdeer yun hogi ke Qayamat ka ilm aur is qaul ka ilm Us ke paas hai. Khatm-e-Surah par irshad hota hai ke mushrikeen se munh mor le aur un ki bad-zabani ka bad-kalami se jawab na do, balkay un ke dil par chhane ki khatir qaul mein aur fe'l mein dono mein narmi barto, keh do ke salam hai. Unhein abhi haqiqat-e-haal maloom ho jayegi. Is mein Rabb-e-Quddus ki taraf se mushrikeen ko bari dhamki hai aur yahi ho kar bhi raha, ke un par woh azaab aaya jo un se tal na saka. Hazrat-e-Haq Jalla Wa 'Ala ne apne deen ko buland-o-bala kiya, apne kalma ko charon taraf phaila diya, apne muwahhid, momin aur muslim bandon ko qawi kar diya aur phir unhein jihad ke aur jala-watan karne ke ahkaam de kar is tarah duniya mein ghalib kar diya. Allah ke deen mein beshumar aadmi dakhil huye aur mashriq-o-maghrib mein Islam phail gaya. Falhamdulillah. Wallahu A'lam.

Azeem-ush-shan Quran-e-Karim ka nuzool aur mah-e-Shaban. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke is azeem-ush-shan Quran-e-Karim ko babarakat raat yani Lailatul Qadr mein nazil farmaya hai. Jaise irshad hai ayat (INNA ANZALNAHU FI LAILATIL QADR) (Surah Al-Qadr: 1) Hum ne ise Lailatul Qadr mein nazil farmaya hai. Aur yeh raat Ramazan-ul-Mubarak mein hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (SHAHRU RAMAZANALLAZI UNZILA FIHIL QUR'ANU HUDAL LINNASI WA BAYYINATIM MINAL HUDA WAL FURQAN) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 185) Ramazan ka mahina woh mahina hai jis mein Quran utara gaya. Surah Baqarah mein is ki poori tafsir guzar chuki hai is liye yahan dobara nahin likhte. Baaz logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke Lailah-e-Mubarakah jis mein Quran Sharif hua woh Shaban ki pandrahvin raat hai, yeh qaul sarasar be-daleel hai. Is liye ke nass-e-Quran se Quran ka Ramazan mein nazil hona sabit hai. Aur jis hadith mein marvi hai ke Shaban mein agle Shaban tak ke tamam kaam muqarrar kar diye jate hain yahan tak ke nikah ka aur aulad ka aur mayyat ka hona bhi, woh hadith mursal hai aur aisi ahadith se nass-e-Qurani ka mu'ariza nahin kiya ja sakta. Hum logon ko aagah kar dene wale hain yani unhein khair-o-sharr, neki-o-badi maloom kara dene wale hain taake makhlooq par hujjat sabit ho jaye aur log ilm-e-shar'i hasil kar lein. Isi shab har muhkam kaam tay kiya jata hai yani Lauh-e-Mahfooz se katib farishton ke hawale kiya jata hai, tamam saal ke kul ahem kaam, umr, rozi wagairah sab tay kar li jati hai. Hakim ke ma'ani muhkam aur mazboot ke hain jo badle nahin, woh sab hamare hukm se hota hai. Hum rusul ke irsal karne wale hain taake woh Allah ki ayatein Allah ke bandon ko parh sunayein jis ki unhein sakht zaroorat aur poori haajat hai. Yeh tere Rabb ki rahmat hai, is rahmat ka karne wala, Quran ko utarne wala aur rasoolon ko bhejne wala woh Allah hai jo aasman, zameen aur kul cheez ka maalik hai aur sab ka khaliq hai. Tum agar yaqeen karne wale ho to is ke bawar karne ke kaafi wujooh majood hain. Phir irshad hua ke ma'bood-e-barhaq bhi sirf wahi hai, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin, har ek ki maut-o-zeest usi ke haath hai, tumhara aur tum se aglon ka sab ka paalne posne wala wahi hai. Is ayat ka mazmoon is ayat jaisa hai (QUL YA AYYUHAN-NASU INNI RASULULLAHI ILAIKUM JAMI'A) (Surah Al-A'raf: 158), yani tu elaan kar de ke ae logo main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka rasool hoon, woh Allah jis ki badshahat hai aasman-o-zameen ki, jis ke siwa koi ma'bood nahin, jo jalata aur marta hai.

Dhuwan hi dhuwan aur kuffar farmata hai ke haq aa chuka aur yeh shak shuba mein aur laho-o-la'ab mein mashghool-o-masroof hain. Inhein us din se aagah kar de jis din aasman se sakht dhuwan aayega. Hazrat Masrooq R.H farmate hain ke hum ek martaba Koofe ki masjid mein gaye jo Kunda ke darwazon ke paas hai to dekha ke ek Hazrat apne sathiyon mein qissa-goi karte hue farmate hain ke is aayat mein jis dhuwein ka zikr hai is se murad woh dhuwan hai jo Qayamat ke din munafiqon ke kanon aur aankhon mein bhar jayega aur mominon ko misl-e-zukam ke ho jayega. Hum wahan se jab wapas laute aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se is ka zikr kiya to aap lete lete betabi ke sath baith gaye aur farmane lage Allah Azzawajal ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya hai main tum se is par koi badla nahin chahta aur main takalluf karne walon mein nahin hoon. Yeh bhi ilm hai ke insaan jis cheez ko na janta ho keh de ke Allah jane, suno main tumhein is aayat ka sahih matlab sunaoon. Jab ke Quraishiyon ne Islam qabool karne mein takheer ki aur Huzoor ﷺ ko satane lage to aap ne un par bad-dua ki ke Yusuf A.S ke zamane jaisa qahat un par aapade. Chunancha woh dua qabool hui aur aisi khushk-sali aayi ke unhon ne haddiyan aur murdar chabana shuru kiya. Aur aasman ki taraf nigahien dalte the to dhuwein ke siwa kuch dikhai na deta tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke wajah-e-bhook ke un ki aankhon mein chakkar aane lage jab aasman ki taraf nazar uthate to darmiyan mein ek dhuwan nazar aata. Isi ka bayan in do aayaton mein hai. Lekin phir is ke baad log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur apni halakat ki shikayat ki. Aap ko reham aa gaya aur aap ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein iltija ki chunancha barish barshi, isi ka bayan is ke baad wali aayat mein hai ke azab ke hat-te hi phir kufr karne lagenge. Is se saaf sabit hai ke yeh duniya ka azab hai kyunke aakhirat ke azab to hat-te, khulte aur door hote nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke paanch cheezein guzar chukin: Dukhan, Room, Qamar, Batsha, aur Lizam (Sahihain). Yani aasman se dhuwein ka aana. Romiyon ka apni shikast ke baad ghalba pana. Chand ke do tukre hona. Badr ki ladai mein kuffar ka pakda jana aur harna. Aur chimat jane wala azab badi sakht pakad se murad Badr ke din ladai hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Nakh'i, Zahhak, Atiya, Aufi, waghera ka hai aur isi ko Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi tarjeeh dete hain. Abdur-Rahman A'raj se marwi hai ke yeh Fatah-e-Makkah ke din hua. Yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb balkay munkar hai aur ba'az hazrat farmate hain yeh guzar nahin gaya balkay qurb-e-Qayamat ke aayega. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Sahaba R.A Qayamat ka zikr kar rahe the aur Huzoor ﷺ aa gaye. To aap ne farmaya jab tak das nishanat tum na dekh lo Qayamat nahin aayegi: Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuwan, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, mashriq, maghrib aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein zameen ka dhansaya jana, aag ka Adan se nikal kar logon ko hank kar ek ja karna. Jahan yeh raat guzarenge aag bhi guzaregi aur jahan yeh dopahar ko soyenge aag bhi qailula karegi.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ibn-e-Sayyad ke liye dil mein aayat (فَارْتَـقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِي السَّمَاۗءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ) (Surah Ad-Dukhan: 10) chhupa kar us se poocha ke bata main ne apne dil mein kya chhupa rakha hai? Us ne kaha (Dukh). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas barbad ho, is se aage teri nahin chalne ki. Is mein bhi ek qisam ka ishara hai ke abhi is ka intezar baqi hai aur yeh koi aane wali cheez hai. Chunke Ibn-e-Sayyad bator-e-kahinon ke baaz baatein dil ki zaban se batane ka mudda'i tha, is ke jhoot ko zahir karne ke liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh kiya aur jab woh poora na bata saka to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is ki halat se waqif kar diya ke is ke sath shaitan hai, kalam sirf chura leta hai aur yeh is se zyada par qudrat nahin paane ka. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ki awwaleen nishaniyan yeh hain: Dajjal ka aana aur Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka nazil hona aur aag ka beech-e-Adan se nikalna jo logon ko mahshar ki taraf le jayegi, qailule ke waqt aur raat ki neend ke waqt bhi un ke sath rahegi aur dhuen ka aana. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dhuan kaisa? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh dhuan chalees din tak ghata rahega jis se musalmanon ko to misl-e-nazle ke ho jayega aur kafir behosh-o-badmast ho jayega, is ke nathnon se, kanon se aur dusri jagah se dhuan nikalta rahega. Yeh hadith agar sahi hoti to phir Dukhan ke ma'ani muqarrar ho jaane mein koi baat baqi na rehti. Lekin is ki sehat ki gawahi nahin di ja sakti. Is ke rawi Rawad se Muhammad bin Khalaf Asqalani ne sawal kiya ke kya Sufyan Thauri se tu ne khud yeh hadith suni hai? Us ne inkar kiya. Poocha kya tu ne padhi aur us ne suni hai? Kaha nahin. Poocha achha tumhari maujoodgi mein us ke samne yeh hadith padhi gayi? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum is hadith ko kaise bayan karte ho? Kaha main ne to bayan nahin ki, mere paas kuch log aaye, is riwayat ko pesh kiya, phir ja kar mere naam se ise bayan karni shuru kar di. Baat bhi yahi hai, yeh hadith bilkul mauzoo hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ise kayi jagah laye hain aur is mein bahut si munkarat hain, khusoosan Masjid-e-Aqsa ke bayan mein jo Surah Bani Israel ke shuru mein hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur hadith mein hai ke tumhare Rabb ne tumhein teen cheezon se daraya: dhuan jo momin ko zukam kar dega aur kafir ka to sara jism phula dega, roein roein se dhuan uthega, Dabbatul-Arz aur Dajjal. Is ki sanad bahut umdah hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain dhuan phail jayega, momin ko to misl-e-zukam ke lagega aur kafir ke jod-jod se niklega. Yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ke qaul se bhi marwi hai aur Hazrat Hasan (R.H) ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain Dukhan guzar nahin gaya balkeh ab aayega. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se dhuen ki babat upar ki hadith ki tarah riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Mulaika (R.H) farmate hain ke ek din subh ke waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas gaya to Aap (R.A) farmane lage raat ko main bilkul nahin soya. Main ne poocha kyun?

Farmaya is liye ke logon se suna ke dum-dar sitara nikla hai toh mujhe andesha hua ke kahin yahi Dukhan na ho, pas subh tak main ne aankh se aankh nahin milayi. Is ki sanad sahih hai aur (Hibr-ul-Ummah) tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke sath sahaba aur tabieen bhi hain aur marfoo hadeesein bhi hain. Jin mein sahih, hasan aur har tarah ki hain aur un se sabit hota hai ke Dukhan ek alamat-e-Qayamat hai jo aane wali hai. Zahiri alfaz-e-Quran bhi isi ki tayeed karte hain kyunke Quran ne ise wazeh aur zahir dhuan kaha hai jise har shakhs dekh sake aur bhook ke dhuen se ise tabeer karna theek nahin kyunke woh toh ek khayali cheez hai, bhook pyas ki sakhti ki wajah se dhuan sa aankhon ke aage namudar ho jata hai jo dar-asal dhuan nahin aur Quran ke alfaz hain ayat (Dukhan-e-Mubeen) ke. Phir yeh farman ke woh logon ko dhank legi, yeh bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki tafseer ki tayeed karta hai kyunke bhook ke is dhuen ne sirf Ahl-e-Makkah ko dhampa tha na ke tamam logon ko. Phir farmata hai ke yeh hai alimnak azab, yani un se yun kaha jaye ga jaise aur ayat mein hai (YAWMA YUD'AUNA ILA NARI JAHANNAMA DA'A) (Surah At-Tur: 13), jis din unhein Jahannam ki taraf dhakela jaye ga ke yeh woh aag hai jise tum jhutla rahe thay. Ya yeh matlab ke woh khud ek dusre se yun kahenge, kafir jab is azab ko dekhenge toh Allah se is ke door hone ki dua karenge jaise ke is ayat mein hai (WA LAU TARA IZ WUQIFU 'ALAN-NARI FAQALU YA LAYTANA NURADDU WA LA NUKADH-DHIBA BI-AYATI RABBINA WA NAKUNA MINAL-MU'MINEEN) (Surah Al-An'am: 27), yani kaash ke tu unhein dekhta jab yeh aag ke paas kharay kiye jayenge aur kahenge kaash ke hum lautaye jate toh hum apne Rabb ki ayaton ko na jhutlate aur ba-iman ban kar rehte. Aur ayat mein hai logon ko daraway ke sath aagah kar de jis din un ke paas azab aaye ga us din gunahgar kahenge Parwardigar humein thore se waqt tak aur dheel de de toh hum teri pukar par labbaik keh lein aur tere rasoolon ki farmabardari kar lein. Pas yahan yahi kaha jata hai ke un ke liye nasihat kahan? Un ke paas mere paighambar aa chuke, unhon ne un ke samne mere ahkam wazeh taur par rakh diye lekin manna toh kuja unhon ne parwah tak na ki, balkay unhein jhoota kaha, un ki taleem ko ghalat kaha aur saaf keh diya ke yeh toh sikhaye parhaye hain, inhein junoon ho gaya hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai us din insan nasihat hasil kare ga lekin ab us ke liye nasihat kahan hai? Aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (WA QALU AMANNA BIHI WA ANNA LAHUMUT-TANAWUSU MIN MAKANIM-BA'EED) (Surah Saba: 52).

Saba: 52, yani us din azabon ko dekh kar imaan lana sarasar besood hai. Phir jo irshad hota hai us ke do ma'ani ho sakte hain. Ek toh yeh ke agar bilfarz hum azab hata lein aur tumhein dobara duniya mein bhej dein toh bhi tum phir wahan ja kar yahi karoge jo is se pehle kar ke aaye ho. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau rahimnahum wa kashafna ma bihim min durrin la-lajju fi tughyanihim ya'mahoon) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 75), yani agar hum in par raham karein aur burai in se hata lein toh phir yeh apni sarkashi mein aankhein band kar ke munhamik ho jayenge. Aur jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau ruddu la'adu lima nuhoo anhu wa innahum la-kaziboon) (6. Al-An'am: 28), yani agar yeh lautaye jayen toh qatan dobara phir hamari nafarmaniyan karne lagenge aur mahaz jhoote sabit honge.

Dusre ma'ani yeh bhi ho sakte hain ke agar azab ke asbab qaim ho chukne aur azab aa jane ke baad bhi go hum use kuch der thahra lein taham yeh apni bad-batini aur khabasat se baaz nahin aane ke. Is se yeh lazim aata ke azab unhein pahuncha aur phir hat gaya, jaise Qaum-e-Yunus ki. Hazrat-e-Haq Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Qaum-e-Yunus jab imaan layi hum ne un se azab hata liya. Goya azab unhein hona shuru nahin hua tha, haan is ke asbab majood-o-faraham ho chuke thay, un tak Allah ka azab pahunch chuka tha aur is se yeh bhi lazim nahin aata ke woh apne kufr se hat gaye thay phir is ki taraf laut gaye.

Chanancha Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) aur un par imaan lane walon se jab qaum ne kaha ke ya toh tum hamari basti chhod do ya hamare mazhab mein laut aao, toh jawab mein Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya ke go hum use bura jante hon, jabke Allah Ta'ala ne hamein is se nijat de rakhi hai, phir bhi agar hum tumhari millat mein laut aayen toh hum se badh kar jhoota aur Allah ke zimme bohtan bandhne wala aur kaun hoga? Zahir hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ne is se pehle bhi kabhi kufr mein qadam nahin rakha tha.

Aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke tum lautne wale ho. Is se matlab Allah ke azab ki taraf lautna hai. Badi aur sakht pakad se murad Jang-e-Badr hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur aap ke sath ki woh jamaat jo Dukhan ko ho chuka manti hai, woh toh (Batsha) ke ma'ani yahi karti hai. Balkeh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se, ek aur jamaat se yahi manqool hai. Go yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke is se murad Qayamat ke din ki pakad hai, go Badr ka din bhi pakad ka aur kuffar par sakht din tha. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke go Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ise Badr ka din batate hain lekin mere nazdeek toh is se murad Qayamat ka din hai, is ki asnaad sahih hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Ikrama (R.H) se bhi dono riwayaton mein zyada sahih riwayat yahi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Dhuwan hi dhuwan aur kuffar farmata hai ke haq aa chuka aur yeh shak shuba mein aur laho-o-la'ab mein mashghool-o-masroof hain. Inhein us din se aagah kar de jis din aasman se sakht dhuwan aayega. Hazrat Masrooq R.H farmate hain ke hum ek martaba Koofe ki masjid mein gaye jo Kunda ke darwazon ke paas hai to dekha ke ek Hazrat apne sathiyon mein qissa-goi karte hue farmate hain ke is aayat mein jis dhuwein ka zikr hai is se murad woh dhuwan hai jo Qayamat ke din munafiqon ke kanon aur aankhon mein bhar jayega aur mominon ko misl-e-zukam ke ho jayega. Hum wahan se jab wapas laute aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se is ka zikr kiya to aap lete lete betabi ke sath baith gaye aur farmane lage Allah Azzawajal ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya hai main tum se is par koi badla nahin chahta aur main takalluf karne walon mein nahin hoon. Yeh bhi ilm hai ke insaan jis cheez ko na janta ho keh de ke Allah jane, suno main tumhein is aayat ka sahih matlab sunaoon. Jab ke Quraishiyon ne Islam qabool karne mein takheer ki aur Huzoor ﷺ ko satane lage to aap ne un par bad-dua ki ke Yusuf A.S ke zamane jaisa qahat un par aapade. Chunancha woh dua qabool hui aur aisi khushk-sali aayi ke unhon ne haddiyan aur murdar chabana shuru kiya. Aur aasman ki taraf nigahien dalte the to dhuwein ke siwa kuch dikhai na deta tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke wajah-e-bhook ke un ki aankhon mein chakkar aane lage jab aasman ki taraf nazar uthate to darmiyan mein ek dhuwan nazar aata. Isi ka bayan in do aayaton mein hai. Lekin phir is ke baad log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur apni halakat ki shikayat ki. Aap ko reham aa gaya aur aap ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein iltija ki chunancha barish barshi, isi ka bayan is ke baad wali aayat mein hai ke azab ke hat-te hi phir kufr karne lagenge. Is se saaf sabit hai ke yeh duniya ka azab hai kyunke aakhirat ke azab to hat-te, khulte aur door hote nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke paanch cheezein guzar chukin: Dukhan, Room, Qamar, Batsha, aur Lizam (Sahihain). Yani aasman se dhuwein ka aana. Romiyon ka apni shikast ke baad ghalba pana. Chand ke do tukre hona. Badr ki ladai mein kuffar ka pakda jana aur harna. Aur chimat jane wala azab badi sakht pakad se murad Badr ke din ladai hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Nakh'i, Zahhak, Atiya, Aufi, waghera ka hai aur isi ko Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi tarjeeh dete hain. Abdur-Rahman A'raj se marwi hai ke yeh Fatah-e-Makkah ke din hua. Yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb balkay munkar hai aur ba'az hazrat farmate hain yeh guzar nahin gaya balkay qurb-e-Qayamat ke aayega. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Sahaba R.A Qayamat ka zikr kar rahe the aur Huzoor ﷺ aa gaye. To aap ne farmaya jab tak das nishanat tum na dekh lo Qayamat nahin aayegi: Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuwan, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, mashriq, maghrib aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein zameen ka dhansaya jana, aag ka Adan se nikal kar logon ko hank kar ek ja karna. Jahan yeh raat guzarenge aag bhi guzaregi aur jahan yeh dopahar ko soyenge aag bhi qailula karegi.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ibn-e-Sayyad ke liye dil mein aayat (فَارْتَـقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِي السَّمَاۗءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ) (Surah Ad-Dukhan: 10) chhupa kar us se poocha ke bata main ne apne dil mein kya chhupa rakha hai? Us ne kaha (Dukh). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas barbad ho, is se aage teri nahin chalne ki. Is mein bhi ek qisam ka ishara hai ke abhi is ka intezar baqi hai aur yeh koi aane wali cheez hai. Chunke Ibn-e-Sayyad bator-e-kahinon ke baaz baatein dil ki zaban se batane ka mudda'i tha, is ke jhoot ko zahir karne ke liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh kiya aur jab woh poora na bata saka to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is ki halat se waqif kar diya ke is ke sath shaitan hai, kalam sirf chura leta hai aur yeh is se zyada par qudrat nahin paane ka. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ki awwaleen nishaniyan yeh hain: Dajjal ka aana aur Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka nazil hona aur aag ka beech-e-Adan se nikalna jo logon ko mahshar ki taraf le jayegi, qailule ke waqt aur raat ki neend ke waqt bhi un ke sath rahegi aur dhuen ka aana. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dhuan kaisa? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh dhuan chalees din tak ghata rahega jis se musalmanon ko to misl-e-nazle ke ho jayega aur kafir behosh-o-badmast ho jayega, is ke nathnon se, kanon se aur dusri jagah se dhuan nikalta rahega. Yeh hadith agar sahi hoti to phir Dukhan ke ma'ani muqarrar ho jaane mein koi baat baqi na rehti. Lekin is ki sehat ki gawahi nahin di ja sakti. Is ke rawi Rawad se Muhammad bin Khalaf Asqalani ne sawal kiya ke kya Sufyan Thauri se tu ne khud yeh hadith suni hai? Us ne inkar kiya. Poocha kya tu ne padhi aur us ne suni hai? Kaha nahin. Poocha achha tumhari maujoodgi mein us ke samne yeh hadith padhi gayi? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum is hadith ko kaise bayan karte ho? Kaha main ne to bayan nahin ki, mere paas kuch log aaye, is riwayat ko pesh kiya, phir ja kar mere naam se ise bayan karni shuru kar di. Baat bhi yahi hai, yeh hadith bilkul mauzoo hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ise kayi jagah laye hain aur is mein bahut si munkarat hain, khusoosan Masjid-e-Aqsa ke bayan mein jo Surah Bani Israel ke shuru mein hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur hadith mein hai ke tumhare Rabb ne tumhein teen cheezon se daraya: dhuan jo momin ko zukam kar dega aur kafir ka to sara jism phula dega, roein roein se dhuan uthega, Dabbatul-Arz aur Dajjal. Is ki sanad bahut umdah hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain dhuan phail jayega, momin ko to misl-e-zukam ke lagega aur kafir ke jod-jod se niklega. Yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ke qaul se bhi marwi hai aur Hazrat Hasan (R.H) ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain Dukhan guzar nahin gaya balkeh ab aayega. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se dhuen ki babat upar ki hadith ki tarah riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Mulaika (R.H) farmate hain ke ek din subh ke waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas gaya to Aap (R.A) farmane lage raat ko main bilkul nahin soya. Main ne poocha kyun?

Farmaya is liye ke logon se suna ke dum-dar sitara nikla hai toh mujhe andesha hua ke kahin yahi Dukhan na ho, pas subh tak main ne aankh se aankh nahin milayi. Is ki sanad sahih hai aur (Hibr-ul-Ummah) tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke sath sahaba aur tabieen bhi hain aur marfoo hadeesein bhi hain. Jin mein sahih, hasan aur har tarah ki hain aur un se sabit hota hai ke Dukhan ek alamat-e-Qayamat hai jo aane wali hai. Phir yeh farman ke woh logon ko dhank legi, yeh bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki tafseer ki tayeed karta hai kyunke bhook ke is dhuen ne sirf Ahl-e-Makkah ko dhampa tha na ke tamam logon ko. Us ne kaha (Dukh). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas barbad ho, is se aage teri nahin chalne ki. Is mein bhi ek qisam ka ishara hai ke abhi is ka intezar baqi hai aur yeh koi aane wali cheez hai. Chunke Ibn-e-Sayyad bator-e-kahinon ke baaz baatein dil ki zaban se batane ka mudda'i tha, is ke jhoot ko zahir karne ke liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh kiya aur jab woh poora na bata saka to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is ki halat se waqif kar diya ke is ke sath shaitan hai, kalam sirf chura leta hai aur yeh is se zyada par qudrat nahin paane ka. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ki awwaleen nishaniyan yeh hain: Dajjal ka aana aur Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka nazil hona aur aag ka beech-e-Adan se nikalna jo logon ko mahshar ki taraf le jayegi, qailule ke waqt aur raat ki neend ke waqt bhi un ke sath rahegi aur dhuen ka aana. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dhuan kaisa? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh dhuan chalees din tak ghata rahega jis se musalmanon ko to misl-e-nazle ke ho jayega aur kafir behosh-o-badmast ho jayega, is ke nathnon se, kanon se aur dusri jagah se dhuan nikalta rahega. Yeh hadith agar sahi hoti to phir Dukhan ke ma'ani muqarrar ho jaane mein koi baat baqi na rehti. Lekin is ki sehat ki gawahi nahin di ja sakti. Is ke rawi Rawad se Muhammad bin Khalaf Asqalani ne sawal kiya ke kya Sufyan Thauri se tu ne khud yeh hadith suni hai? Us ne inkar kiya. Poocha kya tu ne padhi aur us ne suni hai? Kaha nahin. Poocha achha tumhari maujoodgi mein us ke samne yeh hadith padhi gayi? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum is hadith ko kaise bayan karte ho? Kaha main ne to bayan nahin ki, mere paas kuch log aaye, is riwayat ko pesh kiya, phir ja kar mere naam se ise bayan karni shuru kar di. Baat bhi yahi hai, yeh hadith bilkul mauzoo hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ise kayi jagah laye hain aur is mein bahut si munkarat hain, khusoosan Masjid-e-Aqsa ke bayan mein jo Surah Bani Israel ke shuru mein hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur hadith mein hai ke tumhare Rabb ne tumhein teen cheezon se daraya: dhuan jo momin ko zukam kar dega aur kafir ka to sara jism phula dega, roein roein se dhuan uthega, Dabbatul-Arz aur Dajjal. Is ki sanad bahut umdah hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain dhuan phail jayega, momin ko to misl-e-zukam ke lagega aur kafir ke jod-jod se niklega. Yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ke qaul se bhi marwi hai aur Hazrat Hasan (R.H) ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain Dukhan guzar nahin gaya balkeh ab aayega. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se dhuen ki babat upar ki hadith ki tarah riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Mulaika (R.H) farmate hain ke ek din subh ke waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas gaya to Aap (R.A) farmane lage raat ko main bilkul nahin soya. Main ne poocha kyun?

Farmaya is liye ke logon se suna ke dum-dar sitara nikla hai toh mujhe andesha hua ke kahin yahi Dukhan na ho, pas subh tak main ne aankh se aankh nahin milayi. Is ki sanad sahih hai aur (Hibr-ul-Ummah) tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke sath sahaba aur tabieen bhi hain aur marfoo hadeesein bhi hain. Jin mein sahih, hasan aur har tarah ki hain aur un se sabit hota hai ke Dukhan ek alamat-e-Qayamat hai jo aane wali hai. Zahiri alfaz-e-Quran bhi isi ki tayeed karte hain kyunke Quran ne ise wazeh aur zahir dhuan kaha hai jise har shakhs dekh sake aur bhook ke dhuen se ise tabeer karna theek nahin kyunke woh toh ek khayali cheez hai, bhook pyas ki sakhti ki wajah se dhuan sa aankhon ke aage namudar ho jata hai jo dar-asal dhuan nahin aur Quran ke alfaz hain ayat (Dukhan-e-Mubeen) ke. Phir yeh farman ke woh logon ko dhank legi, yeh bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki tafseer ki tayeed karta hai kyunke bhook ke is dhuen ne sirf Ahl-e-Makkah ko dhampa tha na ke tamam logon ko. Phir farmata hai ke yeh hai alimnak azab, yani un se yun kaha jaye ga jaise aur ayat mein hai (YAWMA YUD'AUNA ILA NARI JAHANNAMA DA'A) (Surah At-Tur: 13), jis din unhein Jahannam ki taraf dhakela jaye ga ke yeh woh aag hai jise tum jhutla rahe thay. Ya yeh matlab ke woh khud ek dusre se yun kahenge, kafir jab is azab ko dekhenge toh Allah se is ke door hone ki dua karenge jaise ke is ayat mein hai (WA LAU TARA IZ WUQIFU 'ALAN-NARI FAQALU YA LAYTANA NURADDU WA LA NUKADH-DHIBA BI-AYATI RABBINA WA NAKUNA MINAL-MU'MINEEN) (Surah Al-An'am: 27), yani kaash ke tu unhein dekhta jab yeh aag ke paas kharay kiye jayenge aur kahenge kaash ke hum lautaye jate toh hum apne Rabb ki ayaton ko na jhutlate aur ba-iman ban kar rehte. Aur ayat mein hai logon ko daraway ke sath aagah kar de jis din un ke paas azab aaye ga us din gunahgar kahenge Parwardigar humein thore se waqt tak aur dheel de de toh hum teri pukar par labbaik keh lein aur tere rasoolon ki farmabardari kar lein. Pas yahan yahi kaha jata hai ke un ke liye nasihat kahan? Un ke paas mere paighambar aa chuke, unhon ne un ke samne mere ahkam wazeh taur par rakh diye lekin manna toh kuja unhon ne parwah tak na ki, balkay unhein jhoota kaha, un ki taleem ko ghalat kaha aur saaf keh diya ke yeh toh sikhaye parhaye hain, inhein junoon ho gaya hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai us din insan nasihat hasil kare ga lekin ab us ke liye nasihat kahan hai? Aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (WA QALU AMANNA BIHI WA ANNA LAHUMUT-TANAWUSU MIN MAKANIM-BA'EED) (Surah Saba: 52).

Saba: 52, yani us din azabon ko dekh kar imaan lana sarasar besood hai. Phir jo irshad hota hai us ke do ma'ani ho sakte hain. Ek toh yeh ke agar bilfarz hum azab hata lein aur tumhein dobara duniya mein bhej dein toh bhi tum phir wahan ja kar yahi karoge jo is se pehle kar ke aaye ho. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau rahimnahum wa kashafna ma bihim min durrin la-lajju fi tughyanihim ya'mahoon) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 75), yani agar hum in par raham karein aur burai in se hata lein toh phir yeh apni sarkashi mein aankhein band kar ke munhamik ho jayenge. Aur jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau ruddu la'adu lima nuhoo anhu wa innahum la-kaziboon) (6. Al-An'am: 28), yani agar yeh lautaye jayen toh qatan dobara phir hamari nafarmaniyan karne lagenge aur mahaz jhoote sabit honge.

Dusre ma'ani yeh bhi ho sakte hain ke agar azab ke asbab qaim ho chukne aur azab aa jane ke baad bhi go hum use kuch der thahra lein taham yeh apni bad-batini aur khabasat se baaz nahin aane ke. Is se yeh lazim aata ke azab unhein pahuncha aur phir hat gaya, jaise Qaum-e-Yunus ki. Hazrat-e-Haq Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Qaum-e-Yunus jab imaan layi hum ne un se azab hata liya. Goya azab unhein hona shuru nahin hua tha, haan is ke asbab majood-o-faraham ho chuke thay, un tak Allah ka azab pahunch chuka tha aur is se yeh bhi lazim nahin aata ke woh apne kufr se hat gaye thay phir is ki taraf laut gaye.

Chanancha Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) aur un par imaan lane walon se jab qaum ne kaha ke ya toh tum hamari basti chhod do ya hamare mazhab mein laut aao, toh jawab mein Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya ke go hum use bura jante hon, jabke Allah Ta'ala ne hamein is se nijat de rakhi hai, phir bhi agar hum tumhari millat mein laut aayen toh hum se badh kar jhoota aur Allah ke zimme bohtan bandhne wala aur kaun hoga? Zahir hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ne is se pehle bhi kabhi kufr mein qadam nahin rakha tha.

Aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke tum lautne wale ho. Is se matlab Allah ke azab ki taraf lautna hai. Badi aur sakht pakad se murad Jang-e-Badr hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur aap ke sath ki woh jamaat jo Dukhan ko ho chuka manti hai, woh toh (Batsha) ke ma'ani yahi karti hai. Balkeh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se, ek aur jamaat se yahi manqool hai. Go yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke is se murad Qayamat ke din ki pakad hai, go Badr ka din bhi pakad ka aur kuffar par sakht din tha. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke go Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ise Badr ka din batate hain lekin mere nazdeek toh is se murad Qayamat ka din hai, is ki asnaad sahih hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Ikrama (R.H) se bhi dono riwayaton mein zyada sahih riwayat yahi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Dhuwan hi dhuwan aur kuffar farmata hai ke haq aa chuka aur yeh shak shuba mein aur laho-o-la'ab mein mashghool-o-masroof hain. Inhein us din se aagah kar de jis din aasman se sakht dhuwan aayega. Hazrat Masrooq R.H farmate hain ke hum ek martaba Koofe ki masjid mein gaye jo Kunda ke darwazon ke paas hai to dekha ke ek Hazrat apne sathiyon mein qissa-goi karte hue farmate hain ke is aayat mein jis dhuwein ka zikr hai is se murad woh dhuwan hai jo Qayamat ke din munafiqon ke kanon aur aankhon mein bhar jayega aur mominon ko misl-e-zukam ke ho jayega. Hum wahan se jab wapas laute aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se is ka zikr kiya to aap lete lete betabi ke sath baith gaye aur farmane lage Allah Azzawajal ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya hai main tum se is par koi badla nahin chahta aur main takalluf karne walon mein nahin hoon. Yeh bhi ilm hai ke insaan jis cheez ko na janta ho keh de ke Allah jane, suno main tumhein is aayat ka sahih matlab sunaoon. Jab ke Quraishiyon ne Islam qabool karne mein takheer ki aur Huzoor ﷺ ko satane lage to aap ne un par bad-dua ki ke Yusuf A.S ke zamane jaisa qahat un par aapade. Chunancha woh dua qabool hui aur aisi khushk-sali aayi ke unhon ne haddiyan aur murdar chabana shuru kiya. Aur aasman ki taraf nigahien dalte the to dhuwein ke siwa kuch dikhai na deta tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke wajah-e-bhook ke un ki aankhon mein chakkar aane lage jab aasman ki taraf nazar uthate to darmiyan mein ek dhuwan nazar aata. Isi ka bayan in do aayaton mein hai. Lekin phir is ke baad log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur apni halakat ki shikayat ki. Aap ko reham aa gaya aur aap ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein iltija ki chunancha barish barshi, isi ka bayan is ke baad wali aayat mein hai ke azab ke hat-te hi phir kufr karne lagenge. Is se saaf sabit hai ke yeh duniya ka azab hai kyunke aakhirat ke azab to hat-te, khulte aur door hote nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke paanch cheezein guzar chukin: Dukhan, Room, Qamar, Batsha, aur Lizam (Sahihain). Yani aasman se dhuwein ka aana. Romiyon ka apni shikast ke baad ghalba pana. Chand ke do tukre hona. Badr ki ladai mein kuffar ka pakda jana aur harna. Aur chimat jane wala azab badi sakht pakad se murad Badr ke din ladai hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Nakh'i, Zahhak, Atiya, Aufi, waghera ka hai aur isi ko Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi tarjeeh dete hain. Abdur-Rahman A'raj se marwi hai ke yeh Fatah-e-Makkah ke din hua. Yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb balkay munkar hai aur ba'az hazrat farmate hain yeh guzar nahin gaya balkay qurb-e-Qayamat ke aayega. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Sahaba R.A Qayamat ka zikr kar rahe the aur Huzoor ﷺ aa gaye. To aap ne farmaya jab tak das nishanat tum na dekh lo Qayamat nahin aayegi: Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuwan, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, mashriq, maghrib aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein zameen ka dhansaya jana, aag ka Adan se nikal kar logon ko hank kar ek ja karna. Jahan yeh raat guzarenge aag bhi guzaregi aur jahan yeh dopahar ko soyenge aag bhi qailula karegi.

Zahir hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ne is se pehle bhi kabhi kufr mein qadam nahin rakha tha.

Aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke tum lautne wale ho. Is se matlab Allah ke azab ki taraf lautna hai. Badi aur sakht pakad se murad Jang-e-Badr hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur aap ke sath ki woh jamaat jo Dukhan ko ho chuka manti hai, woh toh (Batsha) ke ma'ani yahi karti hai. Balkeh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se, ek aur jamaat se yahi manqool hai. Go yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke is se murad Qayamat ke din ki pakad hai, go Badr ka din bhi pakad ka aur kuffar par sakht din tha. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke go Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ise Badr ka din batate hain lekin mere nazdeek toh is se murad Qayamat ka din hai, is ki asnaad sahih hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Ikrama (R.H) se bhi dono riwayaton mein zyada sahih riwayat yahi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Dhuwan hi dhuwan aur kuffar farmata hai ke haq aa chuka aur yeh shak shuba mein aur laho-o-la'ab mein mashghool-o-masroof hain. Inhein us din se aagah kar de jis din aasman se sakht dhuwan aayega. Hazrat Masrooq R.H farmate hain ke hum ek martaba Koofe ki masjid mein gaye jo Kunda ke darwazon ke paas hai to dekha ke ek Hazrat apne sathiyon mein qissa-goi karte hue farmate hain ke is aayat mein jis dhuwein ka zikr hai is se murad woh dhuwan hai jo Qayamat ke din munafiqon ke kanon aur aankhon mein bhar jayega aur mominon ko misl-e-zukam ke ho jayega. Hum wahan se jab wapas laute aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se is ka zikr kiya to aap lete lete betabi ke sath baith gaye aur farmane lage Allah Azzawajal ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya hai main tum se is par koi badla nahin chahta aur main takalluf karne walon mein nahin hoon. Yeh bhi ilm hai ke insaan jis cheez ko na janta ho keh de ke Allah jane, suno main tumhein is aayat ka sahih matlab sunaoon. Jab ke Quraishiyon ne Islam qabool karne mein takheer ki aur Huzoor ﷺ ko satane lage to aap ne un par bad-dua ki ke Yusuf A.S ke zamane jaisa qahat un par aapade. Chunancha woh dua qabool hui aur aisi khushk-sali aayi ke unhon ne haddiyan aur murdar chabana shuru kiya. Aur aasman ki taraf nigahien dalte the to dhuwein ke siwa kuch dikhai na deta tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke wajah-e-bhook ke un ki aankhon mein chakkar aane lage jab aasman ki taraf nazar uthate to darmiyan mein ek dhuwan nazar aata. Isi ka bayan in do aayaton mein hai. Lekin phir is ke baad log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur apni halakat ki shikayat ki. Aap ko reham aa gaya aur aap ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein iltija ki chunancha barish barshi, isi ka bayan is ke baad wali aayat mein hai ke azab ke hat-te hi phir kufr karne lagenge. Is se saaf sabit hai ke yeh duniya ka azab hai kyunke aakhirat ke azab to hat-te, khulte aur door hote nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke paanch cheezein guzar chukin: Dukhan, Room, Qamar, Batsha, aur Lizam (Sahihain). Yani aasman se dhuwein ka aana. Romiyon ka apni shikast ke baad ghalba pana. Chand ke do tukre hona. Badr ki ladai mein kuffar ka pakda jana aur harna. Aur chimat jane wala azab badi sakht pakad se murad Badr ke din ladai hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Nakh'i, Zahhak, Atiya, Aufi, waghera ka hai aur isi ko Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi tarjeeh dete hain. Abdur-Rahman A'raj se marwi hai ke yeh Fatah-e-Makkah ke din hua. Yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb balkay munkar hai aur ba'az hazrat farmate hain yeh guzar nahin gaya balkay qurb-e-Qayamat ke aayega. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Sahaba R.A Qayamat ka zikr kar rahe the aur Huzoor ﷺ aa gaye. To aap ne farmaya jab tak das nishanat tum na dekh lo Qayamat nahin aayegi: Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuwan, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, mashriq, maghrib aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein zameen ka dhansaya jana, aag ka Adan se nikal kar logon ko hank kar ek ja karna. Jahan yeh raat guzarenge aag bhi guzaregi aur jahan yeh dopahar ko soyenge aag bhi qailula karegi.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ibn-e-Sayyad ke liye dil mein aayat (فَارْتَـقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِي السَّمَاۗءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ) (Surah Ad-Dukhan: 10) chhupa kar us se poocha ke bata main ne apne dil mein kya chhupa rakha hai? Us ne kaha (Dukh). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas barbad ho, is se aage teri nahin chalne ki. Is mein bhi ek qisam ka ishara hai ke abhi is ka intezar baqi hai aur yeh koi aane wali cheez hai. Chunke Ibn-e-Sayyad bator-e-kahinon ke baaz baatein dil ki zaban se batane ka mudda'i tha, is ke jhoot ko zahir karne ke liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh kiya aur jab woh poora na bata saka to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is ki halat se waqif kar diya ke is ke sath shaitan hai, kalam sirf chura leta hai aur yeh is se zyada par qudrat nahin paane ka. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ki awwaleen nishaniyan yeh hain: Dajjal ka aana aur Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka nazil hona aur aag ka beech-e-Adan se nikalna jo logon ko mahshar ki taraf le jayegi, qailule ke waqt aur raat ki neend ke waqt bhi un ke sath rahegi aur dhuen ka aana. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dhuan kaisa? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh dhuan chalees din tak ghata rahega jis se musalmanon ko to misl-e-nazle ke ho jayega aur kafir behosh-o-badmast ho jayega, is ke nathnon se, kanon se aur dusri jagah se dhuan nikalta rahega. Yeh hadith agar sahi hoti to phir Dukhan ke ma'ani muqarrar ho jaane mein koi baat baqi na rehti. Lekin is ki sehat ki gawahi nahin di ja sakti. Is ke rawi Rawad se Muhammad bin Khalaf Asqalani ne sawal kiya ke kya Sufyan Thauri se tu ne khud yeh hadith suni hai? Us ne inkar kiya. Poocha kya tu ne padhi aur us ne suni hai? Kaha nahin. Poocha achha tumhari maujoodgi mein us ke samne yeh hadith padhi gayi? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum is hadith ko kaise bayan karte ho? Kaha main ne to bayan nahin ki, mere paas kuch log aaye, is riwayat ko pesh kiya, phir ja kar mere naam se ise bayan karni shuru kar di. Baat bhi yahi hai, yeh hadith bilkul mauzoo hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ise kayi jagah laye hain aur is mein bahut si munkarat hain, khusoosan Masjid-e-Aqsa ke bayan mein jo Surah Bani Israel ke shuru mein hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur hadith mein hai ke tumhare Rabb ne tumhein teen cheezon se daraya: dhuan jo momin ko zukam kar dega aur kafir ka to sara jism phula dega, roein roein se dhuan uthega, Dabbatul-Arz aur Dajjal. Is ki sanad bahut umdah hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain dhuan phail jayega, momin ko to misl-e-zukam ke lagega aur kafir ke jod-jod se niklega. Yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ke qaul se bhi marwi hai aur Hazrat Hasan (R.H) ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain Dukhan guzar nahin gaya balkeh ab aayega. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se dhuen ki babat upar ki hadith ki tarah riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Mulaika (R.H) farmate hain ke ek din subh ke waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas gaya to Aap (R.A) farmane lage raat ko main bilkul nahin soya. Main ne poocha kyun?

Farmaya is liye ke logon se suna ke dum-dar sitara nikla hai toh mujhe andesha hua ke kahin yahi Dukhan na ho, pas subh tak main ne aankh se aankh nahin milayi. Is ki sanad sahih hai aur (Hibr-ul-Ummah) tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke sath sahaba aur tabieen bhi hain aur marfoo hadeesein bhi hain. Jin mein sahih, hasan aur har tarah ki hain aur un se sabit hota hai ke Dukhan ek alamat-e-Qayamat hai jo aane wali hai. Zahiri alfaz-e-Quran bhi isi ki tayeed karte hain kyunke Quran ne ise wazeh aur zahir dhuan kaha hai jise har shakhs dekh sake aur bhook ke dhuen se ise tabeer karna theek nahin kyunke woh toh ek khayali cheez hai, bhook pyas ki sakhti ki wajah se dhuan sa aankhon ke aage namudar ho jata hai jo dar-asal dhuan nahin aur Quran ke alfaz hain ayat (Dukhan-e-Mubeen) ke. Phir yeh farman ke woh logon ko dhank legi, yeh bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki tafseer ki tayeed karta hai kyunke bhook ke is dhuen ne sirf Ahl-e-Makkah ko dhampa tha na ke tamam logon ko. Phir farmata hai ke yeh hai alimnak azab, yani un se yun kaha jaye ga jaise aur ayat mein hai (YAWMA YUD'AUNA ILA NARI JAHANNAMA DA'A) (Surah At-Tur: 13), jis din unhein Jahannam ki taraf dhakela jaye ga ke yeh woh aag hai jise tum jhutla rahe thay. Ya yeh matlab ke woh khud ek dusre se yun kahenge, kafir jab is azab ko dekhenge toh Allah se is ke door hone ki dua karenge jaise ke is ayat mein hai (WA LAU TARA IZ WUQIFU 'ALAN-NARI FAQALU YA LAYTANA NURADDU WA LA NUKADH-DHIBA BI-AYATI RABBINA WA NAKUNA MINAL-MU'MINEEN) (Surah Al-An'am: 27), yani kaash ke tu unhein dekhta jab yeh aag ke paas kharay kiye jayenge aur kahenge kaash ke hum lautaye jate toh hum apne Rabb ki ayaton ko na jhutlate aur ba-iman ban kar rehte. Aur ayat mein hai logon ko daraway ke sath aagah kar de jis din un ke paas azab aaye ga us din gunahgar kahenge Parwardigar humein thore se waqt tak aur dheel de de toh hum teri pukar par labbaik keh lein aur tere rasoolon ki farmabardari kar lein. Pas yahan yahi kaha jata hai ke un ke liye nasihat kahan? Un ke paas mere paighambar aa chuke, unhon ne un ke samne mere ahkam wazeh taur par rakh diye lekin manna toh kuja unhon ne parwah tak na ki, balkay unhein jhoota kaha, un ki taleem ko ghalat kaha aur saaf keh diya ke yeh toh sikhaye parhaye hain, inhein junoon ho gaya hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai us din insan nasihat hasil kare ga lekin ab us ke liye nasihat kahan hai? Aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (WA QALU AMANNA BIHI WA ANNA LAHUMUT-TANAWUSU MIN MAKANIM-BA'EED) (Surah Saba: 52).

Saba: 52, yani us din azabon ko dekh kar imaan lana sarasar besood hai. Phir jo irshad hota hai us ke do ma'ani ho sakte hain. Ek toh yeh ke agar bilfarz hum azab hata lein aur tumhein dobara duniya mein bhej dein toh bhi tum phir wahan ja kar yahi karoge jo is se pehle kar ke aaye ho. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau rahimnahum wa kashafna ma bihim min durrin la-lajju fi tughyanihim ya'mahoon) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 75), yani agar hum in par raham karein aur burai in se hata lein toh phir yeh apni sarkashi mein aankhein band kar ke munhamik ho jayenge. Aur jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau ruddu la'adu lima nuhoo anhu wa innahum la-kaziboon) (6. Al-An'am: 28), yani agar yeh lautaye jayen toh qatan dobara phir hamari nafarmaniyan karne lagenge aur mahaz jhoote sabit honge.

Dusre ma'ani yeh bhi ho sakte hain ke agar azab ke asbab qaim ho chukne aur azab aa jane ke baad bhi go hum use kuch der thahra lein taham yeh apni bad-batini aur khabasat se baaz nahin aane ke. Is se yeh lazim aata ke azab unhein pahuncha aur phir hat gaya, jaise Qaum-e-Yunus ki. Hazrat-e-Haq Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Qaum-e-Yunus jab imaan layi hum ne un se azab hata liya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se dhuen ki babat upar ki hadith ki tarah riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Mulaika (R.H) farmate hain ke ek din subh ke waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas gaya to Aap (R.A) farmane lage raat ko main bilkul nahin soya. Main ne poocha kyun?

Farmaya is liye ke logon se suna ke dum-dar sitara nikla hai toh mujhe andesha hua ke kahin yahi Dukhan na ho, pas subh tak main ne aankh se aankh nahin milayi. Is ki sanad sahih hai aur (Hibr-ul-Ummah) tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke sath sahaba aur tabieen bhi hain aur marfoo hadeesein bhi hain. Jin mein sahih, hasan aur har tarah ki hain aur un se sabit hota hai ke Dukhan ek alamat-e-Qayamat hai jo aane wali hai. Zahiri alfaz-e-Quran bhi isi ki tayeed karte hain kyunke Quran ne ise wazeh aur zahir dhuan kaha hai jise har shakhs dekh sake aur bhook ke dhuen se ise tabeer karna theek nahin kyunke woh toh ek khayali cheez hai, bhook pyas ki sakhti ki wajah se dhuan sa aankhon ke aage namudar ho jata hai jo dar-asal dhuan nahin aur Quran ke alfaz hain ayat (Dukhan-e-Mubeen) ke. Phir yeh farman ke woh logon ko dhank legi, yeh bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki tafseer ki tayeed karta hai kyunke bhook ke is dhuen ne sirf Ahl-e-Makkah ko dhampa tha na ke tamam logon ko. Phir farmata hai ke yeh hai alimnak azab, yani un se yun kaha jaye ga jaise aur ayat mein hai (YAWMA YUD'AUNA ILA NARI JAHANNAMA DA'A) (Surah At-Tur: 13), jis din unhein Jahannam ki taraf dhakela jaye ga ke yeh woh aag hai jise tum jhutla rahe thay. Ya yeh matlab ke woh khud ek dusre se yun kahenge, kafir jab is azab ko dekhenge toh Allah se is ke door hone ki dua karenge jaise ke is ayat mein hai (WA LAU TARA IZ WUQIFU 'ALAN-NARI FAQALU YA LAYTANA NURADDU WA LA NUKADH-DHIBA BI-AYATI RABBINA WA NAKUNA MINAL-MU'MINEEN) (Surah Al-An'am: 27), yani kaash ke tu unhein dekhta jab yeh aag ke paas kharay kiye jayenge aur kahenge kaash ke hum lautaye jate toh hum apne Rabb ki ayaton ko na jhutlate aur ba-iman ban kar rehte. Aur ayat mein hai logon ko daraway ke sath aagah kar de jis din un ke paas azab aaye ga us din gunahgar kahenge Parwardigar humein thore se waqt tak aur dheel de de toh hum teri pukar par labbaik keh lein aur tere rasoolon ki farmabardari kar lein. Pas yahan yahi kaha jata hai ke un ke liye nasihat kahan? Un ke paas mere paighambar aa chuke, unhon ne un ke samne mere ahkam wazeh taur par rakh diye lekin manna toh kuja unhon ne parwah tak na ki, balkay unhein jhoota kaha, un ki taleem ko ghalat kaha aur saaf keh diya ke yeh toh sikhaye parhaye hain, inhein junoon ho gaya hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai us din insan nasihat hasil kare ga lekin ab us ke liye nasihat kahan hai? Aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (WA QALU AMANNA BIHI WA ANNA LAHUMUT-TANAWUSU MIN MAKANIM-BA'EED) (Surah Saba: 52).

Saba: 52, yani us din azabon ko dekh kar imaan lana sarasar besood hai. Phir jo irshad hota hai us ke do ma'ani ho sakte hain. Ek toh yeh ke agar bilfarz hum azab hata lein aur tumhein dobara duniya mein bhej dein toh bhi tum phir wahan ja kar yahi karoge jo is se pehle kar ke aaye ho. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau rahimnahum wa kashafna ma bihim min durrin la-lajju fi tughyanihim ya'mahoon) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 75), yani agar hum in par raham karein aur burai in se hata lein toh phir yeh apni sarkashi mein aankhein band kar ke munhamik ho jayenge. Aur jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau ruddu la'adu lima nuhoo anhu wa innahum la-kaziboon) (6. Al-An'am: 28), yani agar yeh lautaye jayen toh qatan dobara phir hamari nafarmaniyan karne lagenge aur mahaz jhoote sabit honge.

Dusre ma'ani yeh bhi ho sakte hain ke agar azab ke asbab qaim ho chukne aur azab aa jane ke baad bhi go hum use kuch der thahra lein taham yeh apni bad-batini aur khabasat se baaz nahin aane ke. Is se yeh lazim aata ke azab unhein pahuncha aur phir hat gaya, jaise Qaum-e-Yunus ki. Hazrat-e-Haq Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Qaum-e-Yunus jab imaan layi hum ne un se azab hata liya. Goya azab unhein hona shuru nahin hua tha, haan is ke asbab majood-o-faraham ho chuke thay, un tak Allah ka azab pahunch chuka tha aur is se yeh bhi lazim nahin aata ke woh apne kufr se hat gaye thay phir is ki taraf laut gaye.

Chanancha Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) aur un par imaan lane walon se jab qaum ne kaha ke ya toh tum hamari basti chhod do ya hamare mazhab mein laut aao, toh jawab mein Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya ke go hum use bura jante hon, jabke Allah Ta'ala ne hamein is se nijat de rakhi hai, phir bhi agar hum tumhari millat mein laut aayen toh hum se badh kar jhoota aur Allah ke zimme bohtan bandhne wala aur kaun hoga? Zahir hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ne is se pehle bhi kabhi kufr mein qadam nahin rakha tha.

Aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke tum lautne wale ho. Is se matlab Allah ke azab ki taraf lautna hai. Badi aur sakht pakad se murad Jang-e-Badr hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur aap ke sath ki woh jamaat jo Dukhan ko ho chuka manti hai, woh toh (Batsha) ke ma'ani yahi karti hai. Balkeh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se, ek aur jamaat se yahi manqool hai. Go yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke is se murad Qayamat ke din ki pakad hai, go Badr ka din bhi pakad ka aur kuffar par sakht din tha. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke go Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ise Badr ka din batate hain lekin mere nazdeek toh is se murad Qayamat ka din hai, is ki asnaad sahih hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Ikrama (R.H) se bhi dono riwayaton mein zyada sahih riwayat yahi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Dhuwan hi dhuwan aur kuffar farmata hai ke haq aa chuka aur yeh shak shuba mein aur laho-o-la'ab mein mashghool-o-masroof hain. Inhein us din se aagah kar de jis din aasman se sakht dhuwan aayega. Hazrat Masrooq R.H farmate hain ke hum ek martaba Koofe ki masjid mein gaye jo Kunda ke darwazon ke paas hai to dekha ke ek Hazrat apne sathiyon mein qissa-goi karte hue farmate hain ke is aayat mein jis dhuwein ka zikr hai is se murad woh dhuwan hai jo Qayamat ke din munafiqon ke kanon aur aankhon mein bhar jayega aur mominon ko misl-e-zukam ke ho jayega. Hum wahan se jab wapas laute aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se is ka zikr kiya to aap lete lete betabi ke sath baith gaye aur farmane lage Allah Azzawajal ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya hai main tum se is par koi badla nahin chahta aur main takalluf karne walon mein nahin hoon. Yeh bhi ilm hai ke insaan jis cheez ko na janta ho keh de ke Allah jane, suno main tumhein is aayat ka sahih matlab sunaoon. Jab ke Quraishiyon ne Islam qabool karne mein takheer ki aur Huzoor ﷺ ko satane lage to aap ne un par bad-dua ki ke Yusuf A.S ke zamane jaisa qahat un par aapade. Chunancha woh dua qabool hui aur aisi khushk-sali aayi ke unhon ne haddiyan aur murdar chabana shuru kiya. Aur aasman ki taraf nigahien dalte the to dhuwein ke siwa kuch dikhai na deta tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke wajah-e-bhook ke un ki aankhon mein chakkar aane lage jab aasman ki taraf nazar uthate to darmiyan mein ek dhuwan nazar aata. Isi ka bayan in do aayaton mein hai. Lekin phir is ke baad log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur apni halakat ki shikayat ki. Aap ko reham aa gaya aur aap ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein iltija ki chunancha barish barshi, isi ka bayan is ke baad wali aayat mein hai ke azab ke hat-te hi phir kufr karne lagenge. Is se saaf sabit hai ke yeh duniya ka azab hai kyunke aakhirat ke azab to hat-te, khulte aur door hote nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke paanch cheezein guzar chukin: Dukhan, Room, Qamar, Batsha, aur Lizam (Sahihain). Yani aasman se dhuwein ka aana. Romiyon ka apni shikast ke baad ghalba pana. Chand ke do tukre hona. Badr ki ladai mein kuffar ka pakda jana aur harna. Aur chimat jane wala azab badi sakht pakad se murad Badr ke din ladai hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Nakh'i, Zahhak, Atiya, Aufi, waghera ka hai aur isi ko Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi tarjeeh dete hain. Abdur-Rahman A'raj se marwi hai ke yeh Fatah-e-Makkah ke din hua. Yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb balkay munkar hai aur ba'az hazrat farmate hain yeh guzar nahin gaya balkay qurb-e-Qayamat ke aayega. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Sahaba R.A Qayamat ka zikr kar rahe the aur Huzoor ﷺ aa gaye. To aap ne farmaya jab tak das nishanat tum na dekh lo Qayamat nahin aayegi: Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuwan, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, mashriq, maghrib aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein zameen ka dhansaya jana, aag ka Adan se nikal kar logon ko hank kar ek ja karna. Jahan yeh raat guzarenge aag bhi guzaregi aur jahan yeh dopahar ko soyenge aag bhi qailula karegi.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ibn-e-Sayyad ke liye dil mein aayat (فَارْتَـقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِي السَّمَاۗءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ) (Surah Ad-Dukhan: 10) chhupa kar us se poocha ke bata main ne apne dil mein kya chhupa rakha hai? Us ne kaha (Dukh). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas barbad ho, is se aage teri nahin chalne ki. Is mein bhi ek qisam ka ishara hai ke abhi is ka intezar baqi hai aur yeh koi aane wali cheez hai. Chunke Ibn-e-Sayyad bator-e-kahinon ke baaz baatein dil ki zaban se batane ka mudda'i tha, is ke jhoot ko zahir karne ke liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh kiya aur jab woh poora na bata saka to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is ki halat se waqif kar diya ke is ke sath shaitan hai, kalam sirf chura leta hai aur yeh is se zyada par qudrat nahin paane ka. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ki awwaleen nishaniyan yeh hain: Dajjal ka aana aur Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka nazil hona aur aag ka beech-e-Adan se nikalna jo logon ko mahshar ki taraf le jayegi, qailule ke waqt aur raat ki neend ke waqt bhi un ke sath rahegi aur dhuen ka aana. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dhuan kaisa? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh dhuan chalees din tak ghata rahega jis se musalmanon ko to misl-e-nazle ke ho jayega aur kafir behosh-o-badmast ho jayega, is ke nathnon se, kanon se aur dusri jagah se dhuan nikalta rahega. Yeh hadith agar sahi hoti to phir Dukhan ke ma'ani muqarrar ho jaane mein koi baat baqi na rehti. Lekin is ki sehat ki gawahi nahin di ja sakti. Is ke rawi Rawad se Muhammad bin Khalaf Asqalani ne sawal kiya ke kya Sufyan Thauri se tu ne khud yeh hadith suni hai? Us ne inkar kiya. Poocha kya tu ne padhi aur us ne suni hai? Kaha nahin. Poocha achha tumhari maujoodgi mein us ke samne yeh hadith padhi gayi? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum is hadith ko kaise bayan karte ho? Kaha main ne to bayan nahin ki, mere paas kuch log aaye, is riwayat ko pesh kiya, phir ja kar mere naam se ise bayan karni shuru kar di. Baat bhi yahi hai, yeh hadith bilkul mauzoo hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ise kayi jagah laye hain aur is mein bahut si munkarat hain, khusoosan Masjid-e-Aqsa ke bayan mein jo Surah Bani Israel ke shuru mein hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur hadith mein hai ke tumhare Rabb ne tumhein teen cheezon se daraya: dhuan jo momin ko zukam kar dega aur kafir ka to sara jism phula dega, roein roein se dhuan uthega, Dabbatul-Arz aur Dajjal.
