Lekin phir is ke baad log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur apni halakat ki shikayat ki. Aap ko reham aa gaya aur aap ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein iltija ki chunancha barish barshi, isi ka bayan is ke baad wali aayat mein hai ke azab ke hat-te hi phir kufr karne lagenge. Is se saaf sabit hai ke yeh duniya ka azab hai kyunke aakhirat ke azab to hat-te, khulte aur door hote nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke paanch cheezein guzar chukin: Dukhan, Room, Qamar, Batsha, aur Lizam (Sahihain). Yani aasman se dhuwein ka aana. Romiyon ka apni shikast ke baad ghalba pana. Chand ke do tukre hona. Badr ki ladai mein kuffar ka pakda jana aur harna. Aur chimat jane wala azab badi sakht pakad se murad Badr ke din ladai hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Nakh'i, Zahhak, Atiya, Aufi, waghera ka hai aur isi ko Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi tarjeeh dete hain. Abdur-Rahman A'raj se marwi hai ke yeh Fatah-e-Makkah ke din hua. Yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb balkay munkar hai aur ba'az hazrat farmate hain yeh guzar nahin gaya balkay qurb-e-Qayamat ke aayega. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Sahaba R.A Qayamat ka zikr kar rahe the aur Huzoor ﷺ aa gaye. To aap ne farmaya jab tak das nishanat tum na dekh lo Qayamat nahin aayegi: Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuwan, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, mashriq, maghrib aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein zameen ka dhansaya jana, aag ka Adan se nikal kar logon ko hank kar ek ja karna. Jahan yeh raat guzarenge aag bhi guzaregi aur jahan yeh dopahar ko soyenge aag bhi qailula karegi.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ibn-e-Sayyad ke liye dil mein aayat (فَارْتَـقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِي السَّمَاۗءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ) (Surah Ad-Dukhan: 10) chhupa kar us se poocha ke bata main ne apne dil mein kya chhupa rakha hai? Us ne kaha (Dukh). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas barbad ho, is se aage teri nahin chalne ki. Is mein bhi ek qisam ka ishara hai ke abhi is ka intezar baqi hai aur yeh koi aane wali cheez hai. Chunke Ibn-e-Sayyad bator-e-kahinon ke baaz baatein dil ki zaban se batane ka mudda'i tha, is ke jhoot ko zahir karne ke liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh kiya aur jab woh poora na bata saka to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is ki halat se waqif kar diya ke is ke sath shaitan hai, kalam sirf chura leta hai aur yeh is se zyada par qudrat nahin paane ka. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ki awwaleen nishaniyan yeh hain: Dajjal ka aana aur Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka nazil hona aur aag ka beech-e-Adan se nikalna jo logon ko mahshar ki taraf le jayegi, qailule ke waqt aur raat ki neend ke waqt bhi un ke sath rahegi aur dhuen ka aana. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dhuan kaisa? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh dhuan chalees din tak ghata rahega jis se musalmanon ko to misl-e-nazle ke ho jayega aur kafir behosh-o-badmast ho jayega, is ke nathnon se, kanon se aur dusri jagah se dhuan nikalta rahega. Yeh hadith agar sahi hoti to phir Dukhan ke ma'ani muqarrar ho jaane mein koi baat baqi na rehti. Lekin is ki sehat ki gawahi nahin di ja sakti. Is ke rawi Rawad se Muhammad bin Khalaf Asqalani ne sawal kiya ke kya Sufyan Thauri se tu ne khud yeh hadith suni hai? Us ne inkar kiya. Poocha kya tu ne padhi aur us ne suni hai? Kaha nahin. Poocha achha tumhari maujoodgi mein us ke samne yeh hadith padhi gayi? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum is hadith ko kaise bayan karte ho? Kaha main ne to bayan nahin ki, mere paas kuch log aaye, is riwayat ko pesh kiya, phir ja kar mere naam se ise bayan karni shuru kar di. Baat bhi yahi hai, yeh hadith bilkul mauzoo hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ise kayi jagah laye hain aur is mein bahut si munkarat hain, khusoosan Masjid-e-Aqsa ke bayan mein jo Surah Bani Israel ke shuru mein hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur hadith mein hai ke tumhare Rabb ne tumhein teen cheezon se daraya: dhuan jo momin ko zukam kar dega aur kafir ka to sara jism phula dega, roein roein se dhuan uthega, Dabbatul-Arz aur Dajjal. Is ki sanad bahut umdah hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain dhuan phail jayega, momin ko to misl-e-zukam ke lagega aur kafir ke jod-jod se niklega. Yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ke qaul se bhi marwi hai aur Hazrat Hasan (R.H) ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain Dukhan guzar nahin gaya balkeh ab aayega. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se dhuen ki babat upar ki hadith ki tarah riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Abi Mulaika (R.H) farmate hain ke ek din subh ke waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas gaya to Aap (R.A) farmane lage raat ko main bilkul nahin soya. Main ne poocha kyun?

Farmaya is liye ke logon se suna ke dum-dar sitara nikla hai toh mujhe andesha hua ke kahin yahi Dukhan na ho, pas subh tak main ne aankh se aankh nahin milayi. Is ki sanad sahih hai aur (Hibr-ul-Ummah) tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke sath sahaba aur tabieen bhi hain aur marfoo hadeesein bhi hain. Jin mein sahih, hasan aur har tarah ki hain aur un se sabit hota hai ke Dukhan ek alamat-e-Qayamat hai jo aane wali hai. Zahiri alfaz-e-Quran bhi isi ki tayeed karte hain kyunke Quran ne ise wazeh aur zahir dhuan kaha hai jise har shakhs dekh sake aur bhook ke dhuen se ise tabeer karna theek nahin kyunke woh toh ek khayali cheez hai, bhook pyas ki sakhti ki wajah se dhuan sa aankhon ke aage namudar ho jata hai jo dar-asal dhuan nahin aur Quran ke alfaz hain ayat (Dukhan-e-Mubeen) ke. Phir yeh farman ke woh logon ko dhank legi, yeh bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki tafseer ki tayeed karta hai kyunke bhook ke is dhuen ne sirf Ahl-e-Makkah ko dhampa tha na ke tamam logon ko. Phir farmata hai ke yeh hai alimnak azab, yani un se yun kaha jaye ga jaise aur ayat mein hai (YAWMA YUD'AUNA ILA NARI JAHANNAMA DA'A) (Surah At-Tur: 13), jis din unhein Jahannam ki taraf dhakela jaye ga ke yeh woh aag hai jise tum jhutla rahe thay. Ya yeh matlab ke woh khud ek dusre se yun kahenge, kafir jab is azab ko dekhenge toh Allah se is ke door hone ki dua karenge jaise ke is ayat mein hai (WA LAU TARA IZ WUQIFU 'ALAN-NARI FAQALU YA LAYTANA NURADDU WA LA NUKADH-DHIBA BI-AYATI RABBINA WA NAKUNA MINAL-MU'MINEEN) (Surah Al-An'am: 27), yani kaash ke tu unhein dekhta jab yeh aag ke paas kharay kiye jayenge aur kahenge kaash ke hum lautaye jate toh hum apne Rabb ki ayaton ko na jhutlate aur ba-iman ban kar rehte. Aur ayat mein hai logon ko daraway ke sath aagah kar de jis din un ke paas azab aaye ga us din gunahgar kahenge Parwardigar humein thore se waqt tak aur dheel de de toh hum teri pukar par labbaik keh lein aur tere rasoolon ki farmabardari kar lein. Pas yahan yahi kaha jata hai ke un ke liye nasihat kahan? Un ke paas mere paighambar aa chuke, unhon ne un ke samne mere ahkam wazeh taur par rakh diye lekin manna toh kuja unhon ne parwah tak na ki, balkay unhein jhoota kaha, un ki taleem ko ghalat kaha aur saaf keh diya ke yeh toh sikhaye parhaye hain, inhein junoon ho gaya hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai us din insan nasihat hasil kare ga lekin ab us ke liye nasihat kahan hai? Aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (WA QALU AMANNA BIHI WA ANNA LAHUMUT-TANAWUSU MIN MAKANIM-BA'EED) (Surah Saba: 52).

Saba: 52, yani us din azabon ko dekh kar imaan lana sarasar besood hai. Phir jo irshad hota hai us ke do ma'ani ho sakte hain. Ek toh yeh ke agar bilfarz hum azab hata lein aur tumhein dobara duniya mein bhej dein toh bhi tum phir wahan ja kar yahi karoge jo is se pehle kar ke aaye ho. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau rahimnahum wa kashafna ma bihim min durrin la-lajju fi tughyanihim ya'mahoon) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 75), yani agar hum in par raham karein aur burai in se hata lein toh phir yeh apni sarkashi mein aankhein band kar ke munhamik ho jayenge. Aur jaise farmaya aayat (Wa lau ruddu la'adu lima nuhoo anhu wa innahum la-kaziboon) (6. Al-An'am: 28), yani agar yeh lautaye jayen toh qatan dobara phir hamari nafarmaniyan karne lagenge aur mahaz jhoote sabit honge.

Dusre ma'ani yeh bhi ho sakte hain ke agar azab ke asbab qaim ho chukne aur azab aa jane ke baad bhi go hum use kuch der thahra lein taham yeh apni bad-batini aur khabasat se baaz nahin aane ke. Is se yeh lazim aata ke azab unhein pahuncha aur phir hat gaya, jaise Qaum-e-Yunus ki. Hazrat-e-Haq Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Qaum-e-Yunus jab imaan layi hum ne un se azab hata liya. Goya azab unhein hona shuru nahin hua tha, haan is ke asbab majood-o-faraham ho chuke thay, un tak Allah ka azab pahunch chuka tha aur is se yeh bhi lazim nahin aata ke woh apne kufr se hat gaye thay phir is ki taraf laut gaye.

Chanancha Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) aur un par imaan lane walon se jab qaum ne kaha ke ya toh tum hamari basti chhod do ya hamare mazhab mein laut aao, toh jawab mein Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya ke go hum use bura jante hon, jabke Allah Ta'ala ne hamein is se nijat de rakhi hai, phir bhi agar hum tumhari millat mein laut aayen toh hum se badh kar jhoota aur Allah ke zimme bohtan bandhne wala aur kaun hoga? Zahir hai ke Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ne is se pehle bhi kabhi kufr mein qadam nahin rakha tha.

Aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke tum lautne wale ho. Is se matlab Allah ke azab ki taraf lautna hai. Badi aur sakht pakad se murad Jang-e-Badr hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur aap ke sath ki woh jamaat jo Dukhan ko ho chuka manti hai, woh toh (Batsha) ke ma'ani yahi karti hai. Balkeh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se, ek aur jamaat se yahi manqool hai. Go yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke is se murad Qayamat ke din ki pakad hai, go Badr ka din bhi pakad ka aur kuffar par sakht din tha. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke go Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ise Badr ka din batate hain lekin mere nazdeek toh is se murad Qayamat ka din hai, is ki asnaad sahih hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Ikrama (R.H) se bhi dono riwayaton mein zyada sahih riwayat yahi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.
