Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Qibtiyon ka anjam irshad hota hai ke in mushrikeen se pehle Misr ke Qibtiyon ko hum ne jancha, un ki taraf apne buzurg rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko bheja. Unhon ne mera paigham pohanchaya ke Bani Israel ko mere sath kardo, unhein dukh na do. Main apni nabuwwat par gawahi dene wale mojze apne sath laya hoon aur hidayat ke manne wale salamti se rahenge. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apni wahi ka amanat dar bana kar tumhari taraf bheja hai, main tumhein us ka paigham pohancha raha hoon, tumhein Rabb ki baton ke manne se sarkashi na karni chahiye, us ke bayan karda dalail-o-ahkam ke samne sar-e-tasleem kham karna chahiye. Us ki ibadaton se jee churane wale zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam wasil hote hain, main to tumhare samne khuli daleel aur wazeh aayat rakhta hoon, main tumhari badgoi aur ehtamam se Allah ki panah leta hoon. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Saleh (R.H) to yahi kehte hain aur Qatada (R.H) kehte hain murad pathrao karna, pathron se maar dalna hai, yani zabani eiza se aur dasti eiza se main apne Rabb ki jo tumhara bhi malik hai panah chahta hoon. Acha agar tum meri nahin mante, mujh par bharosa nahin karte, Allah par iman nahin late to kam az kam meri takleef-dehi aur eiza-rasani se to baz raho. Aur us ke muntazir raho jab ke khud Allah hum mein tum mein faisla kar dega. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Phir jab Allah ke Nabi Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ek lambi muddat un mein guzari, khoob dil khol khol kar tableegh kar li, har tarah ki khair-khwahi ki, un ki hidayat ke liye harchand jatan kar liye aur dekha ke woh roz-ba-roz apne kufr mein barhte jate hain to Allah Ta'ala se un ke liye bad-dua ki, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne kaha: "Ae hamare Rabb! Tu ne Firaun aur us ke umara ko dunyawi numaish aur maal-o-mata de rakhi hai, ae Allah! Yeh is se dusron ko bhi teri rah se bhatka rahe hain, tu in ka maal gharat kar aur in ke dil aur sakht kar de taake dardnak azabon ke mu'aine tak unhein iman naseeb hi na ho." Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke: "Ae Musa aur ae Haroon! Main ne tumhari dua qabool kar li, ab tum istiqamat par tal jao." Yahan farmata hai ke hum ne Musa (A.S) se kaha ke mere bandon yani Bani Israel ko raton-raat Firaun aur Firauniyon ki be-khabari mein yahan se le kar chale jao. Yeh kuffar tumhara peecha karenge lekin tum be-khauf-o-khatar chale jao, main tumhare liye darya ko khushk kar doonga. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar chal pare, Firauni lashkar ma' Firaun ke un ke pakarne ko chala, beech mein darya hail hua, aap Bani Israel ko le kar is mein utar gaye, darya ka pani sookh gaya aur aap apne sathiyon samet paar ho gaye, to chaha ke darya par lakri maar kar use keh dein ke ab tu apni rawani par aa ja taake Firaun is se guzar na sake, wahin Allah ne wahi bheji ke use isi haal mein sukoon ke sath hi rehne do, sath hi is ki wajah bhi bata di ke yeh sab isi mein doob marein ge.

Phir toh tum sab bilkul hi mutma'in aur be-khauf ho jao ge. Garz hukm hua tha ke dariya ko khushk chhor kar chal dein. (Rahwan) ke ma'ani sookha rasta jo asli halat par ho. Maqsad yeh hai ke paar ho kar dariya ko rawani ka hukm na dena yahan tak ke dushmanon mein se ek-ek is mein aa na jaye, ab ise jaari hone ka hukm milte hi sab ko garq kar de ga. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai dekho kaise gharat hue. Baghaat, khetiyan, nahrein, makanat aur baithakein sab chhor kar fana ho gaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Misr ka dariya-e-Neel mashriq-o-maghrib ke dariyaon ka sardar hai aur sab nahrein is ke matahat hain. Jab is ki rawani Allah ko manzoor hoti hai toh tamam nehron ko is mein pani pahunchane ka hukm hota hai, jahan tak Rabb ko manzoor ho is mein pani aa jata hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aur nehron ko rok deta hai aur hukm deta hai ke ab apni-apni jagah chali jao. Aur Firauniyon ke yeh baghaat dariya-e-Neel ke dono kinaron par musalsal chale gaye thay, Raswan se le kar Rashid tak is ka silsila tha aur is ki nau khaleijein thin. Khaleij-e-Iskandariya, Dumyat, Khaleij-e-Sardos, Khaleij-e-Munsif, Khaleij-e-Muntahi aur in sab mein ittisal tha, ek dusre se mutassil thin aur paharon ke daman mein in ki khetiyan thin jo Misr se le kar dariya tak barabar chali aati thin. In tamam ko bhi dariya sairab karta tha, bare amn-o-chain ki zindagi guzar rahe thay lekin maghroor ho gaye aur aakhir sari ne'matein yunhi chhor kar tabah kar diye gaye. Maal, aulad, jaah-o-maal, saltanat-o-izzat ek hi raat mein chhor gaye aur bhus ki tarah ura diye gaye aur guzishta kal ki tarah be-nishan kar diye gaye. Aise duboye gaye ke ubhar na sake, Jahannam wasil ho gaye aur badtareen jagah pahunch gaye. In ki yeh tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ko de dein. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya hai ke hum ne in kamzoron ko in ke sabr ke badle is sarkash qaum ki kul ne'matein ata farma dein aur be-imano ka bharkas nikal dala. Yahan bhi dusri qaum jise waris banaya is se murad bhi Bani Israel hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke in par zameen-o-aasman na roye kyunke in papiyon ke nek a'maal thay hi nahin jo aasmanon par charhte hon aur ab in ke na charhne ki wajah se woh afsos karein, na zameen mein in ki jaghein aisi thin ke jahan baith kar yeh Allah ki ibadat karte hon aur aaj inhe na pa kar zameen ki woh jagah in ka matam kare. Inhe mohlat na di gayi. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mausili mein hai har bande ke liye aasman mein do darwaze hain, ek se is ki rozi utarti hai dusre se is ke a'maal aur is ke kalam charhte hain.

Jab yeh marjata hai aur woh amal-o-rizq ko gum shuda paate hain toh rote hain, phir isi aayat ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Islam gurbat se shuru hua aur phir gurbat par aajayega. Yaad rakho momin kahin anjam musafir ki tarah nahin, momin jahan kahin safar mein hota hai jahan uska koi rone wala na ho, wahan bhi uske rone wale aasman-o-zameen majood hain. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh dono kuffar par rote nahin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne poocha ke aasman-o-zameen kabhi kisi par roye bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya aaj tu ne woh baat daryaft ki hai ke tujh se pehle mujh se is ka sawal kisi ne nahin kiya. Suno har bande ke liye zameen mein ek namaz ki jagah hoti hai aur ek jagah aasman mein uske amal ke charhne ki hoti hai aur Aal-e-Firaun ke nek aamal hi na thay, is wajah se na zameen un par royi na aasman ko un par rona aaya aur na unhein dheel di gayi ke koi neki baja la sakein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh sawal hua toh aap ne bhi qareeb qareeb yahi jawab diya, balkay aap se marwi hai ke chalees din tak zameen momin par roti rehti hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ne jab yeh bayan farmaya toh kisi ne is par ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya, aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaunsi baat hai? Jo banda zameen ko apne ruku-o-sujood se aabad rakhta tha, jis bande ki takbeer-o-tasbeeh ki aawazein aasman barabar sunta raha tha, bhala yeh dono is aabid-e-Allah par royenge nahin? Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Firauniyon jaise zaleel-o-khwar logon par yeh kyun rote? Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain duniya jab se rachayi gayi hai tab se aasman sirf do shakhson par roya hai. Unke shagird se sawal hua ke kya aasman-o-zameen har imandar par rote nahin? Farmaya sirf utna hissa jis hisse se uska nek amal charhta tha. Suno aasman ka rona uska surkh hona aur misl-e-nari ke gulabi hojana hai, so yeh haal sirf do shakhson ki shahadat par hua hai. Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ke qatl ke mauqay par toh aasman surkh hogaya aur khoon barsane laga aur dusre Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ke qatl par bhi aasman ka rang surkh hogaya tha (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yazeed Ibn-e-Abu Ziyad ka qaul hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ki wajah se chaar mah tak aasman ke kinare surkh rahe aur yahi surkhi uska rona hai. Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain is ke kinaron ka surkh hojana is ka rona hai. Yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke qatl-e-Hussain ke din jis patthar ko ulta jata tha us ke neeche se munjamid khoon nikalta tha. Is din suraj ko bhi gehan laga hua tha, aasman ke kinare bhi surkh thay aur patthar gire thay. Lekin yeh sab baatein be-bunyaad hain aur Shiaon ke ghare hue afsanay hain. Is mein koi shak nahin ke nawasa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ka waqea nihayat dard-angez aur hasrat-o-afsos wala hai, lekin is par Shiaon ne jo hashia charhaya hai aur ghar-ghara kar jo baatein phaila di hain woh mehez jhoot aur bilkul gap hain.

Khayal toh farmaiye ke is se bahut zyada ahem waqiyat hue aur qatl-e-Husain se bahut badi wardatein huin lekin un ke hone par bhi aasman-o-zameen waghera mein yeh inqilab na hua. Aap hi ke walid-e-majid Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi qatl kiye gaye jo bil-ijma aap se afzal thay lekin na toh pattharon talay se khoon nikla aur na kuch hua. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ko gher liya jata hai aur nihayat bedardi se bila-wajah zulm-o-sitam ke sath unhein qatl kiya jata hai. Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko subh ki namaz parhate hue namaz ki jagah hi qatl kiya jata hai, yeh woh zabardast museebat thi ke is se pehle musalmanon ko kabhi aisi museebat nahin pahunchayi gayi thi lekin in waqiyat mein se kisi waqiye ke waqt in mein se ek bhi baat nahin jo shiyon ne maqtal-e-Husain ki nisbat mashhoor kar rakhi hai. In sab ko bhi jaanay dijiye, tamam insanon ke deeni aur dunyawi sardar Sayyid-ul-Bashar Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko lijiye, jis roz aap (ﷺ) rehlat farmate hain in mein se kuch bhi nahin hota. Aur suniye, jis roz Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hota hai, ittefaqan usi roz suraj grahan hota hai aur koi keh deta hai ke Ibrahim (R.A) ke inteqal ki wajah se suraj ko grahan laga hai, toh Huzoor (ﷺ) grahan ki namaz ada kar ke foran khutbay par kharay ho jate hain aur farmate hain: Suraj aur chand Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain, kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se inhein grahan nahin lagta. Is ke baad ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel par apna ehsan jatata hai ke hum ne unhein Firaun jaise mutakabbir, hudood-shikan ke zaleel azabon se nijat di. Us ne Bani Israel ko past-o-khwar kar rakha tha, zaleel khidmaten un se leta tha aur apne nafs ko tolta rehta tha, khudi aur khud-beeni mein laga hua tha, bewaqoofi se kisi cheez ki had-bandi ka khayal nahin karta tha, Allah ki zameen mein sarkashi kiye hue tha. Aur in badkariyon mein us ki qoum bhi us ke sath thi. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur meherbani ka zikr farma raha hai ke is zamane ke tamam logon par unhein fazeelat ata farmayi. Har zamane ko aalam kaha jata hai, yeh murad nahin ke tamam aglon pichlon par unhein buzurgi di. Yeh aayat bhi us aayat ki tarah hai jis mein farman hai: (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami, fakhuz ma ataituka wa kun minash-shakirin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 144). Is se bhi yahi matlab hai ke is zamane ki tamam aurton par aap ko fazeelat hai, is liye ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Khadija (R.A) un se yaqeenan afzal hain ya kam-az-kam barabar. Isi tarah Hazrat Asiya bint-e-Muzahim jo Firaun ki biwi thin aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki fazeelat tamam aurton par aisi hai jaisi fazeelat shorbay mein bhigoyi roti ki aur khanon par. Phir Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan bayan ho raha hai ke hum ne unhein woh hujjat-o-burhan, daleel-o-nishan aur mojizat-o-karamat ata farmaye jin mein hidayat ki talash karne walon ke liye saaf saaf imtihan tha.

Shahanshah-e-Tubba ki kahani yahan mushrikeen ka inkar-e-Qayamat aur us ki daleel bayan farma kar Allah Ta'ala us ki tardeed karta hai. Un ka khayal tha ke Qayamat aani nahin, marne ke baad jeena nahin. Hashr aur Nashr sab ghalat hai. Daleel yeh pesh karte the ke hamare baap dada mar gaye, woh kyun dobara jee kar nahin aaye? Khayal kijiye yeh kis qadar bodi aur behuda daleel hai. Dobara uth khada hona marne ke baad jeena Qayamat ko hoga na ke duniya mein phir laut kar aayenge. Us din yeh zalim Jahannam ka indhan banenge. Us waqt yeh ummat agli ummaton par gawahi degi aur un par un ke Nabi (ﷺ) gawahi denge. Phir Allah Ta'ala unhein dara raha hai ke kahin aisa na ho ke hamare jo azab usi jurm par agli qomon par aaye woh tum par bhi aa jayen aur un ki tarah benam-o-nishan kar diye jao. Un ke waqiyat Surah Saba mein guzar chuke hain. Woh log bhi Qahtan ke Arab the jaise yeh Adnan ke Arab hain. Humair jo Saba ke the woh apne badshah ko Tubba kehte the, jaise Fars ke badshah ko Kisra aur Room ke har badshah ko Qaisar aur Misr ke har badshah ko Firaun aur Habsha ke har badshah ko Najashi kaha jata hai. In mein se ek Tubba Yaman se nikla aur zameen phirta raha, Samarqand pahunch gaya, har jagah ke badshahon ko shikast deta raha aur apna bahut bada mulk kar liya. Zabardast lashkar aur beshumar riyaya us ke matahat thi. Us ne Hira nami basti basayi. Yeh apne zamane mein Madine mein bhi aaya tha aur yahan ke bashindon se bhi lada lekin use logon ne us se roka. Khud Ahl-e-Madina ka bhi us se yeh sulook raha ke din ko to ladte the aur raat ko un ki mehman dari karte the. Aakhir us ko bhi lihaz aa gaya aur ladai band kar di. Us ke sath yahan ke do Yahudi aalim ho gaye the jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke sache deen ke aamil bhi the. Woh use har waqt bhalai burai samjhate rehte the. Unhon ne kaha ke aap Madine ko takht-o-taraj nahin kar sakte kyunke yeh aakhir zamane ke Paighambar (ﷺ) ki hijrat ki jagah hai. Pas yahan se laut gaya aur un donon aalimon ko apne sath leta chala. Jab yeh Makkah pahuncha to us ne Baitullah ko girana chaha lekin un donon aalimon ne use roka aur is pak ghar ki azmat-o-hurmat bayan ki aur kaha ke is ke bani Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain. Aur is Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman ke hathon phir is ki asli azmat aashkara ho jayegi. Chunancha yeh apne irade se baaz aaya balkeh Baitullah ki badi tazeem-o-takreem ki, tawaf kiya, ghilaf chadhaya aur yahan se Yaman wapas chala gaya. Khud Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke deen mein dakhil hua aur tamam Yaman mein yahi deen phailaya. Us waqt tak Hazrat Maseeh (A.S) ka zuhoor nahin hua tha aur us zamane walon ke liye yahi sacha deen tha. Is tarah ke waqiyat bahut tafseel se Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein majood hain. Aur Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir (R.H) bhi apni kitab mein bahut tafseel ke sath laye hain. Is mein hai ke us ka paye-takht Damishq mein tha, us ke lashkaron ki safein Damishq se lekar Yaman tak pahunchti thin. Ek hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain: Main nahin jaan saka ke had lagne se gunah ka kaffara ho jata hai ya nahin?

Aur na mujhe yeh maloom hai ke Tubba' mal'oon tha ya nahin? Aur na mujhe yeh khabar hai ke Zulqarnain Nabi thay ya badshah aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh bhi farmaya Hazrat Uzair Paighambar thay ya nahin? (Ibn Abi Hatim). Dar Qutni farmatay hain is hadith ki riwayat sirf Abdur Razzaq se hi hai aur sanad se marwi hai ke Hazrat Uzair ka Nabi hona mujhe maloom nahin na main yeh jaanta hoon ke Tubba' par la'nat karoon ya nahin? Isay warid karne ke baad Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ne woh riwayatein darj ki hain jin mein Tubba' ko gaali dene aur la'nat karne se muman'at aayi hai jaise ke hum bhi warid karenge Insha'Allah. Maloom aisa hota hai ke yeh pehle kafir thay phir musalman ho gaye yani Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah ke deen mein dakhil huye aur us zamane ke ulama ke haath par iman qabool kiya. Ba'sat-e-Masih se pehle ka yeh waqea hai Jurhum ke zamane mein Baitullah ka hajj bhi kiya ghilaf bhi charhaya aur bari ta'zeem-o-takreem ki chhay hazar oont naam-e-Allah qurban kiye aur bhi bohat bara taweel waqea hai jo Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas se marwi hai. Aur asal qissa ka daromadar Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam par hai. Wahab bin Munabbah ne bhi is qissay ko warid kiya hai Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ne is Tubba' ke qissay ke sath dusre Tubba' ke qissay ko bhi mila diya hai jo un ke bohat baad tha us ki qoum toh us ke haath par musalman ho gayi thi phir un ke inteqal ke baad woh kufr ki taraf laut gayi. Aur dobara aag aur buton ki parastish shuru kar di. Jaise ke Surah Saba mein mazkoor hai isi ki tafsir mein hum ne bhi wahan is ki poori tafseel likh di hai, Falhamdulillah. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmatay hain is Tubba' ne Ka'bay par ghilaf charhaya tha aap logon ko mana karte thay ke is Tubba' ko bura na kaho yeh darmiyan ka Tubba' hai is ka naam As'ad Abu Karb bin Malkikarib Yamani hai. Is ki saltanat teen sau chhabees saal tak rahi is se zyada lambi muddat in badshahon mein se kisi ne nahin payi. Huzoor ﷺ se taqreeban saat sau saal pehle is ka inteqal hua hai. Muwarrikheen ne yeh bhi bayan kiya hai ke in dono Musawi aalimon ne jo Madinay ke thay unhon ne jab Tubba' badshah ko yaqeen dilaya ke yeh shehar Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman Hazrat Ahmad ﷺ ka hijrat-gah hai toh us ne ek qaseeda kaha tha aur ahl-e-Madina ko bator-e-amanat de gaya tha jo un ke paas hi raha aur bator-e-meeras ek dusre ke haath lagta raha aur is ki riwayat sanad ke sath barabar chali aati rahi yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ki hijrat ke waqt is ke hafiz Abu Ayyub Khalid bin Zaid Razi Allahu Anhu thay aur ittefaq se balkay ba-hukm-e-Allah Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ka nuzool-e-ijlal bhi yahin hua tha is qaseeday ke yeh ashaar mulahiza hon (Shahadtu 'ala Ahmada annahu Rasoolun minallahi bari-un-nasim, Falau mudda 'umri ila 'umrihi lakuntu wazeeran lahu wabna 'amm, Wa jahadtu bis-saifi a'daahu wa farrajtu 'an sadrihi kulla gham). Yani meri teh-e-dil se gawahi hai ke Hazrat Ahmad Mujtaba ﷺ us Allah ke sachay Rasool hain jo tamam jaandaron ka paida karne wala hai.

Agar main us ke zamane tak zinda raha toh qasam Allah ki aap ka saathi aur aap ka muawin ban kar rahunga aur aap ke dushmanon se talwar ke sath jihad karunga aur kisi khatke aur gham ko aap ke paas tak phatakne na dunga. Ibn Abi Dunya mein hai ke daur-e-Islam mein Safa shehar mein ittefaq se qabr khud gayi toh dekha gaya ke do auratein madfoon hain jin ke jism bilkul salim hain aur sarhane par chandi ki ek takhti lagi hui hai jis mein sone ke huroof se yeh likha hua hai ke yeh qabr Hayyi aur Lamees ki hai aur ek riwayat mein un ke naam Habbi aur Tamakhar hain yeh dono Tubba ki behnein hain yeh dono marte waqt tak is baat ki shahadat deti rahin ke laiq-e-ibadat sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai yeh dono Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek nahin karti thin. Un se pehle ke tamam nek saleh log bhi isi shahadat ko ada karte hue inteqal farmate rahe hain. Surah Saba mein hum ne is waqiye ke mutaliq Saba ke ashaar bhi naqal kar diye hain. Hazrat Ka'ab R.A farmaya karte the ke Tubba ki tareef Quran se is tarah maloom hoti hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki qoum ki muzammat ki un ki nahin ki. Hazrat Ayesha R.A se manqool hai ke Tubba ko bura na kaho woh saleh shakhs tha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Tubba ko gaali na do woh musalman ho chuka tha. Tabrani aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Abdur Razzaq mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke mujhe maloom nahin Tubba Nabi tha ya na tha? Aur riwayat mein is se pehle guzar chuki ke main nahin janta Tubba maloon tha ya nahin? Fallahu A'lam. Yehi riwayat Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Atta bin Abu Rabah R.H farmate hain Tubba ko gaali na do Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein bura kehna mana farmaya hai. Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam.

Unhon ne kaha ke aap Madine ko takht-o-taraj nahin kar sakte kyunke yeh aakhir zamane ke Paighambar (ﷺ) ki hijrat ki jagah hai. Pas yahan se laut gaya aur un donon aalimon ko apne sath leta chala. Jab yeh Makkah pahuncha to us ne Baitullah ko girana chaha lekin un donon aalimon ne use roka aur is pak ghar ki azmat-o-hurmat bayan ki aur kaha ke is ke bani Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain. Aur is Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman ke hathon phir is ki asli azmat aashkara ho jayegi. Chunancha yeh apne irade se baaz aaya balkeh Baitullah ki badi tazeem-o-takreem ki, tawaf kiya, ghilaf chadhaya aur yahan se Yaman wapas chala gaya. Khud Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke deen mein dakhil hua aur tamam Yaman mein yahi deen phailaya. Us waqt tak Hazrat Maseeh (A.S) ka zuhoor nahin hua tha aur us zamane walon ke liye yahi sacha deen tha. Is tarah ke waqiyat bahut tafseel se Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein majood hain. Aur Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir (R.H) bhi apni kitab mein bahut tafseel ke sath laye hain. Is mein hai ke us ka paye-takht Damishq mein tha, us ke lashkaron ki safein Damishq se lekar Yaman tak pahunchti thin. Ek hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain: Main nahin jaan saka ke had lagne se gunah ka kaffara ho jata hai ya nahin?

Aur na mujhe yeh maloom hai ke Tubba' mal'oon tha ya nahin? Aur na mujhe yeh khabar hai ke Zulqarnain Nabi thay ya badshah aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh bhi farmaya Hazrat Uzair Paighambar thay ya nahin? (Ibn Abi Hatim). Dar Qutni farmatay hain is hadith ki riwayat sirf Abdur Razzaq se hi hai aur sanad se marwi hai ke Hazrat Uzair ka Nabi hona mujhe maloom nahin na main yeh jaanta hoon ke Tubba' par la'nat karoon ya nahin? Isay warid karne ke baad Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ne woh riwayatein darj ki hain jin mein Tubba' ko gaali dene aur la'nat karne se muman'at aayi hai jaise ke hum bhi warid karenge Insha'Allah. Maloom aisa hota hai ke yeh pehle kafir thay phir musalman ho gaye yani Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah ke deen mein dakhil huye aur us zamane ke ulama ke haath par iman qabool kiya. Ba'sat-e-Masih se pehle ka yeh waqea hai Jurhum ke zamane mein Baitullah ka hajj bhi kiya ghilaf bhi charhaya aur bari ta'zeem-o-takreem ki chhay hazar oont naam-e-Allah qurban kiye aur bhi bohat bara taweel waqea hai jo Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas se marwi hai. Aur asal qissa ka daromadar Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam par hai. Wahab bin Munabbah ne bhi is qissay ko warid kiya hai Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ne is Tubba' ke qissay ke sath dusre Tubba' ke qissay ko bhi mila diya hai jo un ke bohat baad tha us ki qoum toh us ke haath par musalman ho gayi thi phir un ke inteqal ke baad woh kufr ki taraf laut gayi. Aur dobara aag aur buton ki parastish shuru kar di. Jaise ke Surah Saba mein mazkoor hai isi ki tafsir mein hum ne bhi wahan is ki poori tafseel likh di hai, Falhamdulillah. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmatay hain is Tubba' ne Ka'bay par ghilaf charhaya tha aap logon ko mana karte thay ke is Tubba' ko bura na kaho yeh darmiyan ka Tubba' hai is ka naam As'ad Abu Karb bin Malkikarib Yamani hai. Is ki saltanat teen sau chhabees saal tak rahi is se zyada lambi muddat in badshahon mein se kisi ne nahin payi. Huzoor ﷺ se taqreeban saat sau saal pehle is ka inteqal hua hai. Muwarrikheen ne yeh bhi bayan kiya hai ke in dono Musawi aalimon ne jo Madinay ke thay unhon ne jab Tubba' badshah ko yaqeen dilaya ke yeh shehar Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman Hazrat Ahmad ﷺ ka hijrat-gah hai toh us ne ek qaseeda kaha tha aur ahl-e-Madina ko bator-e-amanat de gaya tha jo un ke paas hi raha aur bator-e-meeras ek dusre ke haath lagta raha aur is ki riwayat sanad ke sath barabar chali aati rahi yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ki hijrat ke waqt is ke hafiz Abu Ayyub Khalid bin Zaid Razi Allahu Anhu thay aur ittefaq se balkay ba-hukm-e-Allah Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ka nuzool-e-ijlal bhi yahin hua tha is qaseeday ke yeh ashaar mulahiza hon (Shahadtu 'ala Ahmada annahu Rasoolun minallahi bari-un-nasim, Falau mudda 'umri ila 'umrihi lakuntu wazeeran lahu wabna 'amm, Wa jahadtu bis-saifi a'daahu wa farrajtu 'an sadrihi kulla gham). Yani meri teh-e-dil se gawahi hai ke Hazrat Ahmad Mujtaba ﷺ us Allah ke sachay Rasool hain jo tamam jaandaron ka paida karne wala hai.

Agar main us ke zamane tak zinda raha toh qasam Allah ki aap ka saathi aur aap ka muawin ban kar rahunga aur aap ke dushmanon se talwar ke sath jihad karunga aur kisi khatke aur gham ko aap ke paas tak phatakne na dunga. Ibn Abi Dunya mein hai ke daur-e-Islam mein Safa shehar mein ittefaq se qabr khud gayi toh dekha gaya ke do auratein madfoon hain jin ke jism bilkul salim hain aur sarhane par chandi ki ek takhti lagi hui hai jis mein sone ke huroof se yeh likha hua hai ke yeh qabr Hayyi aur Lamees ki hai aur ek riwayat mein un ke naam Habbi aur Tamakhar hain yeh dono Tubba ki behnein hain yeh dono marte waqt tak is baat ki shahadat deti rahin ke laiq-e-ibadat sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai yeh dono Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek nahin karti thin. Un se pehle ke tamam nek saleh log bhi isi shahadat ko ada karte hue inteqal farmate rahe hain. Surah Saba mein hum ne is waqiye ke mutaliq Saba ke ashaar bhi naqal kar diye hain. Hazrat Ka'ab R.A farmaya karte the ke Tubba ki tareef Quran se is tarah maloom hoti hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki qoum ki muzammat ki un ki nahin ki. Hazrat Ayesha R.A se manqool hai ke Tubba ko bura na kaho woh saleh shakhs tha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Tubba ko gaali na do woh musalman ho chuka tha. Tabrani aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Abdur Razzaq mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke mujhe maloom nahin Tubba Nabi tha ya na tha? Aur riwayat mein is se pehle guzar chuki ke main nahin janta Tubba maloon tha ya nahin? Fallahu A'lam. Yehi riwayat Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Atta bin Abu Rabah R.H farmate hain Tubba ko gaali na do Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein bura kehna mana farmaya hai. Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam.

Agar main us ke zamane tak zinda raha toh qasam Allah ki aap ka saathi aur aap ka muawin ban kar rahunga aur aap ke dushmanon se talwar ke sath jihad karunga aur kisi khatke aur gham ko aap ke paas tak phatakne na dunga. Ibn Abi Dunya mein hai ke daur-e-Islam mein Safa shehar mein ittefaq se qabr khud gayi toh dekha gaya ke do auratein madfoon hain jin ke jism bilkul salim hain aur sarhane par chandi ki ek takhti lagi hui hai jis mein sone ke huroof se yeh likha hua hai ke yeh qabr Hayyi aur Lamees ki hai aur ek riwayat mein un ke naam Habbi aur Tamakhar hain yeh dono Tubba ki behnein hain yeh dono marte waqt tak is baat ki shahadat deti rahin ke laiq-e-ibadat sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai yeh dono Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek nahin karti thin. Un se pehle ke tamam nek saleh log bhi isi shahadat ko ada karte hue inteqal farmate rahe hain. Surah Saba mein hum ne is waqiye ke mutaliq Saba ke ashaar bhi naqal kar diye hain. Hazrat Ka'ab R.A farmaya karte the ke Tubba ki tareef Quran se is tarah maloom hoti hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki qoum ki muzammat ki un ki nahin ki. Hazrat Ayesha R.A se manqool hai ke Tubba ko bura na kaho woh saleh shakhs tha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Tubba ko gaali na do woh musalman ho chuka tha. Tabrani aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Abdur Razzaq mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke mujhe maloom nahin Tubba Nabi tha ya na tha? Aur riwayat mein is se pehle guzar chuki ke main nahin janta Tubba maloon tha ya nahin? Fallahu A'lam. Yehi riwayat Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Atta bin Abu Rabah R.H farmate hain Tubba ko gaali na do Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein bura kehna mana farmaya hai. Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam.

Soor phoonkne ke baad yahan Allah Azza-wa-Jal apne adl ka bayan farma raha hai aur be-faida laghw aur abas kamon se apni pakeezgi ka izhar farmata hai jaise aur aayat mein irshad hai ke hum ne apni makhlooq ko batil paida nahin kiya, aisa guman hamari nisbat sirf un ka hai jo kuffar hain aur jin ka thikana jahannam hai aur irshad hai aayat (Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum abasan wa annakum ilayna la turja'oon) al-kh, yani kya tum ne yeh samajh rakha hai ke hum ne tumhein bekar-o-abas paida kiya hai aur tum laut kar hamari taraf aane hi ke nahin? Allah haq malik bulandiyon aur buzurgiyon wala hai us ke siwa koi mabood nahin woh Arsh-e-Kareem ka Rabb hai. Faislon ka din yani Qayamat ka din jis din Bari Ta'ala apne bandon ke darmiyan haq faisle kare ga, kafiron ko saza aur mominon ko jaza mile gi. Us din tamam agle pichle Allah ke samne jama honge, yeh woh waqt hoga ke ek dusre se juda ho jaye ga, rishte-dar rishte-dar ko koi nafa na pahuncha sake ga jaise Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ka farman hai aayat (Fa-iza nufikha fis-soori fala ansaba bainahum yawma'izin wala yatasa'aloon) (Surah Al-Mu'minoon: 101) yani jab soor phoonk diya jaye ga to na to koi nasab baqi rahe ga na pooch guch. Aur aayat mein hai koi dost us din apne dost ko pareshan hali mein dekhte hue bhi kuch na pooche ga aur na koi us din kisi ki kisi tarah ki madad kare ga na aur koi bairooni madad aaye gi magar haan Allah ki rahmat jo makhlooq par shamil hai, woh bada ghalib aur wasee rahmat wala hai.

Zaqqoom Abu Jahl ki khurak hoga. Munkireen-e-Qayamat ko jo saza wahan di jaye gi us ka bayan ho raha hai ke in mujrimon ko jo apne qaul aur fe'l ko nafarmani se mulawwis kiye hue thay aaj Zaqqoom ka darakht khilaya jaye ga. Ba'az kehte hain is se murad Abu Jahl hai. Go darasal woh bhi is ayat ki wa'eed mein dakhil hai lekin yeh na samjha jaye ke ayat sirf usi ke haq mein nazil hui hai. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ek shakhs ko yeh ayat parha rahe thay magar us ki zaban se lafz (Atheem) ada nahin hota tha aur woh bajaye is ke Yateem keh diya karta tha to aap ne use (Ta'am-ul-Fajir) parhwaya yani use is ke siwa khane ko aur kuch na diya jaye ga. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke agar Zaqqoom ka ek qatra bhi zameen mein tapak jaye to tamam zameen walon ki ma'ash kharab kar de. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai jo pehle bayan ho chuki hai, yeh misl talchhat ke hoga. Apni hararat, badmazgi aur nuqsan ke ba'is pait mein josh marta rahe ga. Allah Ta'ala Jahannam ke darogon se farmaye ga ke is kafir ko pakar lo, wahin sattar hazar farishtay dorenge, use andha kar ke munh ke bal ghaseet le jao aur beech Jahannam mein daal do, phir us ke sar par josh marta garam pani daalo. Jaise farmaya ayat (Yusabbu min fawqi ru'usihimul hameem) (22. Al-Hajj: 19), yani un ke saron par Jahannam ka josh marta garam pani bahaya jaye ga jis se un ki khalein aur pait ke andar ki tamam cheezein sokht ho jayengi aur yeh bhi hum pehle bayan kar aaye hain ke farishtay unhein lohay ke hathore marenge jin se un ka dimagh pash pash ho jayenge, phir upar se yeh Hameem un par dala jaye ga, yeh jahan jahan pohanche ga haddi ko khal se juda kar de ga yahan tak ke us ki aantein kaat-ta hua pindliyon tak pohanch jaye ga. Allah hamein mehfooz rakhe. Phir unhein sharmsar karne ke liye aur zyada pasheman banane ke liye kaha jaye ga ke lo maza chakho, tum hamari nigahon mein na izzat wale ho na buzurgi wale. Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Abu Jahl mal'oon se kaha ke mujhe Allah ka hukm hua hai ke tujh se keh doon tere liye wail hai, tujh par afsos hai, phir mukarrar kehta hoon ke tere liye kharabi aur afsos hai. Is paji ne apna kapra aap ke hath se ghaseet-te hue kaha ja tu aur tera Rabb mera kya bigar sakte ho? Is tamam wadi mein sab se zyada izzat-o-takreem wala main hoon. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne use Badr wale din qatl karaya aur use zaleel kiya aur us se kaha jaye ga ke le ab apni izzat ka aur apni takreem ka aur apni buzurgi aur barai ka lutf utha aur in kafiron se kaha jaye ga ke yeh hai jis mein hamesha shak shuba karte rahe. Jaise aur ayaton mein hai ke jis din unhein dhakke de kar Jahannam mein pohanchaya jaye ga aur kaha jaye ga ke yeh woh dozakh hai jise tum jhutlate rahe, kya yeh jadoo hai ya tum dekh nahin rahe? Isi ko yahan bhi farmaya hai ke yeh jis mein tum shak kar rahe thay.

Jaise aur ayaton mein hai ke jis din unhein dhakke de kar Jahannam mein pohanchaya jaye ga aur kaha jaye ga ke yeh woh dozakh hai jise tum jhutlate rahe, kya yeh jadoo hai ya tum dekh nahin rahe? Isi ko yahan bhi farmaya hai ke yeh jis mein tum shak kar rahe thay.

Jab maut ko zibah karaya jaye ga, badbakhton ka zikr kar ke ab nek-bakhton ka haal bayan ho raha hai. Isi liye Quran-e-Kareem ko Masani kaha gaya hai. Is duniya mein jo Allah Ta'ala Malik-o-Khaliq-o-Qadir se darte-dubte rahe, woh Qayamat ke din Jannat mein nihayat amn-o-aman se honge. Maut se, wahan se nikalne ke, gham-o-ranj, ghabrahat, mushkilon, dukh-dard, takleef, mashaqqat, Shaitan aur us ke makr se, Rabb ki narazgi se, gharz tamam aafton aur museebaton se nadar, be-fikr, mutma'in aur be-andesha honge. Jahannumiyon ko toh Zaqqoom ka darakht aur aag jaisa garam pani mile ga aur unhein Jannatein aur nahrein milengi. Mukhtalif qisam ke reshmi parcha-jaat unhein pehanne ko milenge jin mein narm bareek bhi hoga aur dabeez chamkila bhi hoga. Yeh takhton par bade tamtaraq se takiye lagaye baithe honge aur kisi ki kisi ki taraf peeth na hogi, balkeh sab ek dusre ke samne baithe hue honge. Is ata ke sath hi unhein hoorein di jayengi jo gore-chitte pande ki, badi-badi raseeli aankhon wali hongi, jin ke paak jism ko un se pehle kisi ne chhua bhi na hoga. Woh yaqoot-o-marjan ki tarah hongi. Aur kyun na ho, jab unhon ne Allah ka dar dil mein rakha aur duniya ki khwahishon ki cheezon se mehez farman-e-Allah ko mad-e-nazar rakh kar bache rahe, toh Allah Ta'ala un ke sath yeh behtareen sulook kyun na karta? Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke agar un hooron mein se koi khari samundar mein thook de toh us ka sara pani meetha ho jaye. Phir wahan yeh jis meway ki talab karenge, maujood hoga; jo mangenge mile ga, idhar irada kiya idhar maujood hua, khwahish hui aur hazir hua. Phir nihayat be-fikri se, kami ka khauf nahin hoga, khatam ho jane ka khatka nahin hoga. Phir farmaya wahan unhein kabhi maut nahin aayegi. Phir istisna-e-munqata la kar is ki takeed kar di. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke maut ko bhediye ki surat mein la kar Jannat-Dozakh ke darmiyan zibah kar diya jaye ga aur nida kar di jaye gi ke Jannatiyo! ab hameshangi hai, kabhi maut nahin. Aur ae Jahannumiyo! tumhare liye bhi hamesha rehna hai, kabhi maut na aayegi. Surah Maryam ki tafsir mein bhi yeh hadith guzar chuki hai. Sahih Muslim waghera mein hai ke Jannatiyon se keh diya jaye ga ke tum hamesha tandurust rahoge, kabhi bimar na padoge aur hamesha zinda rahoge, kabhi maroge nahin aur hamesha ne'maton mein rahoge, kabhi kami na hogi aur hamesha jawan bane rahoge, kabhi budhe na hoge. Aur hadith mein hai jo Allah se darta rahe ga, Jannat mein jaye ga jahan ne'matein payega, kabhi mohtaj na hoga, jiye ga kabhi marega nahin, jahan kapde maile na honge aur jawani fana na hogi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke kya Jannati soyein ge bhi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya neend maut ki behan hai, Jannati soyein ge nahin, har waqt rahat-o-lazzat mein mashghool rahenge. Yeh hadith aur sanadon se bhi marwi hai aur is se pehle sanadon ka khilaf guzar chuka hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is rahat-o-ne'mat ke sath yeh bhi badi ne'mat hai ke unhein Parwardigar-e-Aalam ne azab-e-Jahannum se nijat de di hai.

Toh matloob hasil hai aur khauf zail hai, isi liye saath hi farmaya ke yeh sirf Allah Ta'ala ka ehsan-o-fazl hai. Sahih hadith mein hai, "Tum theek thaak raho, qareeb qareeb raho aur yaqeen mano ke kisi ke a'maal usay jannat mein nahin le ja sakte." Logon ne kaha, "Kya aap ke a'maal bhi?" Farmaya, "Haan, mere a'maal bhi, magar yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ka fazl aur uski rahmat mere shamil-e-haal ho." Hum ne apne nazil karda is Quran-e-Kareem ko bahut sahal, bilkul aasaan, saaf zahir, bahut wazeh, mudallal aur roshan kar ke tujh par teri zaban mein nazil farmaya hai, jo bahut faseeh-o-baleeh, badi sheereen aur pukhta hai, taake log ba-aasani samajh lein aur ba-khushi amal karein. Bawajood is ke bhi jo log isay jhutlayein, na maanein, toh unhein hoshiyar kar de aur keh de ke achha ab tum bhi intezar karo, main bhi muntazir hoon. Tum dekh loge ke Allah ki taraf se ta'eed hoti hai? Kis ka kalma buland hota hai? Kisay duniya aur aakhirat milti hai? Matlab yeh hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) tum tasalli rakho, fath-o-zafar tumhein hogi. Meri aadat hai ke apne nabiyon aur un ke manne walon ko ooncha karoon, jaise irshad hai aayat (KATABALLAHU LA-AGHLIBANNA ANA WA RUSULI, INNALLAHA QAWIYYUN AZEEZ) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21), yani Allah Ta'ala ne yeh likh diya hai ke main aur mere rasool hi ghalib rahenge. Aur aayat mein hai (INNA LANANSURU RUSULANA WALLAZINA AAMANU FIL-HAYATID-DUNYA WA YAUMA YAQUMUL-ASH-HAD) (Surah Ghafir: 51), yani yaqeenan hum apne paighambaron ki aur iman walon ki duniya mein bhi madad karenge aur qayamat mein bhi, jis din gawah qaim honge aur zalimon ko un ke uzr nafa na denge, un par la'nat hogi aur un ke liye bura ghar hoga.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke maut ko bhediye ki surat mein la kar Jannat-Dozakh ke darmiyan zibah kar diya jaye ga aur nida kar di jaye gi ke Jannatiyo! ab hameshangi hai, kabhi maut nahin. Aur hadith mein hai jo Allah se darta rahe ga, Jannat mein jaye ga jahan ne'matein payega, kabhi mohtaj na hoga, jiye ga kabhi marega nahin, jahan kapde maile na honge aur jawani fana na hogi. Is rahat-o-ne'mat ke sath yeh bhi badi ne'mat hai ke unhein Parwardigar-e-Aalam ne azab-e-Jahannum se nijat de di hai.

Toh matloob hasil hai aur khauf zail hai, isi liye saath hi farmaya ke yeh sirf Allah Ta'ala ka ehsan-o-fazl hai. Sahih hadith mein hai, "Tum theek thaak raho, qareeb qareeb raho aur yaqeen mano ke kisi ke a'maal usay jannat mein nahin le ja sakte." Logon ne kaha, "Kya aap ke a'maal bhi?" Farmaya, "Haan, mere a'maal bhi, magar yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ka fazl aur uski rahmat mere shamil-e-haal ho." Hum ne apne nazil karda is Quran-e-Kareem ko bahut sahal, bilkul aasaan, saaf zahir, bahut wazeh, mudallal aur roshan kar ke tujh par teri zaban mein nazil farmaya hai, jo bahut faseeh-o-baleeh, badi sheereen aur pukhta hai, taake log ba-aasani samajh lein aur ba-khushi amal karein. Yeh takhton par bade tamtaraq se takiye lagaye baithe honge aur kisi ki kisi ki taraf peeth na hogi, balkeh sab ek dusre ke samne baithe hue honge.
